AI.title_translation: [重审] 评估LLM在基于可评分游戏的谈判能力基准
AI.tldr: 我们重新测试了用于评估LLM谈判能力的“可评分游戏”基准，发现它虽然复杂，但模型间的比较结果不明确，表明其客观性可能存在问题，并指出了原始实验设计中的缺陷，强调了评估时上下文的重要性。
AI.motivation: 旨在调查Abdelnabi等人（2024）提出的基于可评分游戏的谈判基准的再现性、可用性和泛化性，以解决当前评估框架缺乏稳健性和通用性的问题。
AI.method: 复现Abdelnabi等人（2024）在Scoreable Games上的原始实验，并在额外模型上进行验证，同时引入额外的指标来验证谈判质量和评估的公平性，并对基准的扩展版本进行了更广泛的模型行为分析。
AI.result: 发现该基准确实复杂，但模型比较存在歧义，引发了对其客观性的质疑。同时，指出了实验设置的局限性，特别是信息泄露检测和消融研究的彻底性方面的问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了上下文在模型比较评估中的重要性，并为使用该基准的用户提供了额外的背景信息和对原始工作局限性的深入理解。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多智能体谈判任务中展现出巨大潜力，然而由于缺乏稳健和可泛化的基准，该领域的评估仍然具有挑战性。Abdelnabi等人（2024）引入了一个基于可评分游戏的谈判基准，旨在为LLMs开发一个高度复杂和逼真的评估框架。我们的工作调查了其基准中声明的可再现性，并对其可用性和泛化性提供了更深入的理解。我们将原始实验扩展到额外的模型上，并引入了额外的指标来验证谈判质量和评估的公平性。我们的研究结果表明，尽管该基准确实很复杂，但模型比较是模糊的，这对其客观性提出了质疑。此外，我们指出了实验设置中的局限性，特别是在信息泄露检测和消融研究的彻底性方面。通过检查和分析更广泛的模型在扩展基准上的行为，我们揭示了为潜在用户提供额外背景信息的新见解。我们的结果突显了上下文在模型比较评估中的重要性。
AI.summary: 本研究重新审视了基于可评分游戏的LLM谈判基准，通过在更多模型上复现实验并引入新指标来验证其质量和公平性。研究发现该基准复杂但模型比较存在歧义，质疑了其客观性，并指出了原始实验设置中的不足，强调了上下文在模型比较评估中的关键作用。
AI.keywords: LLM, 谈判基准, 可评分游戏, 模型比较, 评估重现性
AI.comments: 这项工作通过复现和扩展先前的工作，深入探讨了基于可评分游戏的LLM谈判基准的可靠性和局限性。其创新点在于引入了额外的评估指标并指出了原始实验设置中信息泄露和消融研究的不足，强调了上下文在模型比较评估中的重要性。然而，其局限性在于原始基准的客观性仍受质疑，且模型比较存在歧义。

title: Thinking by Subtraction: Confidence-Driven Contrastive Decoding for LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent work on test-time scaling for large language model (LLM) reasoning typically assumes that allocating more inference-time computation uniformly improves correctness. However, prior studies show that reasoning uncertainty is highly localized: a small subset of low-confidence tokens disproportionately contributes to reasoning errors and unnecessary output expansion. Motivated by this observation, we propose Thinking by Subtraction, a confidence-driven contrastive decoding approach that improves reasoning reliability through targeted token-level intervention. Our method, Confidence-Driven Contrastive Decoding, detects low-confidence tokens during decoding and intervenes selectively at these positions. It constructs a contrastive reference by replacing high-confidence tokens with minimal placeholders, and refines predictions by subtracting this reference distribution at low-confidence locations. Experiments show that CCD significantly improves accuracy across mathematical reasoning benchmarks while substantially reducing output length, with minimal KV-cache overhead. As a training-free method, CCD enhances reasoning reliability through targeted low-confidence intervention without computational redundancy. Our code will be made available at: https://github.com/bolo-web/CCD.

AI.title_translation: 以减法进行思考：置信度驱动的对比解码用于LLM推理
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为CCD的无需训练的解码策略，它不再盲目增加计算量，而是通过识别并“减去”低置信度标记带来的错误影响（通过构造对比参考），从而显著提高LLM在数学推理上的准确性并缩短输出。
AI.motivation: 现有的测试时间扩展方法通常假定均匀分配更多推理计算可以提高LLM推理的正确性。然而，先前的研究表明推理不确定性高度集中，少数低置信度的标记不成比例地导致了推理错误和不必要的输出扩展。因此，需要一种能针对性干预的方法。
AI.method: 提出的方法是置信度驱动的对比解码（Confidence-Driven Contrastive Decoding, CCD）。该方法在解码过程中检测低置信度标记，并通过构造一个对比参考（用最小占位符替换高置信度标记）来干预这些位置，通过从参考分布中“减去”该分布来精炼预测。
AI.result: 实验表明，CCD显著提高了数学推理基准测试的准确性，同时大幅减少了输出长度，且KV缓存开销极小。
AI.conclusion: CCD（Confidence-Driven Contrastive Decoding）通过有针对性地干预低置信度标记，提高了数学推理的准确性，并显著减少了输出长度，同时保持了极低的KV缓存开销。该方法作为一种无需训练的方法，通过有针对性的低置信度干预增强了推理的可靠性，避免了计算冗余。
AI.translation: 最近关于大型语言模型（LLM）推理的测试时间扩展工作通常假设分配更多的推理时间计算可以统一提高正确性。然而，先前的研究表明推理不确定性是高度局部的：一小部分低置信度的标记不成比例地导致了推理错误和不必要的输出扩展。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了“以减法进行思考”（Thinking by Subtraction），这是一种置信度驱动的对比解码方法，它通过有针对性的标记级干预来提高推理可靠性。我们的方法，置信度驱动的对比解码（CCD），在解码过程中检测低置信度标记并在这些位置进行选择性干预。它通过用最小占位符替换高置信度标记来构建一个对比参考，并通过在低置信度位置减去该参考分布来精炼预测。实验表明，CCD在数学推理基准测试中显著提高了准确性，同时大幅减少了输出长度，且KV缓存开销极小。作为一种无需训练的方法，CCD通过有针对性的低置信度干预增强了推理可靠性，而没有计算冗余。我们的代码将在：https://github.com/bolo-web/CCD 公开。
AI.summary: “以减法进行思考”（Thinking by Subtraction）提出了一种名为置信度驱动的对比解码（CCD）的方法，用于提高大型语言模型（LLM）推理的可靠性。该方法针对推理过程中错误高度集中的低置信度标记进行有选择性的干预，通过构建一个“减去”对比参考分布的机制来精炼预测，从而在不增加计算冗余的情况下，提升了准确率并缩短了输出。
AI.keywords: 对比解码, 置信度驱动, LLM推理, 标记干预, 减法思维
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于“以减法进行思考”的理念，通过有针对性地干预低置信度标记，而不是均匀增加计算量，解决了LLM推理中错误高度集中于少数低置信度标记的问题。其对比参考的构建方式（用占位符替换高置信度标记）是实现“减法”的关键技术点。该方法是训练无关的，且计算开销小，具有很高的实用价值。

title: A Dichotomy Theorem for Automatic Structures
summary: The field of constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs) studies homomorphism problems between relational structures where the target structure is fixed. Classifying the complexity of these problems has been a central quest of the field, notably when both sides are finite structures. In this paper, we study the generalization where the input is an automatic structure -- potentially infinite, but describable by finite automata. We prove a striking dichotomy: homomorphism problems over automatic structures are either decidable in non-deterministic logarithmic space (NL), or undecidable. We show that structures for which the problem is decidable are exactly those with finite duality, which is a classical property of target structures asserting that the existence of a homomorphism into them can be characterized by the absence of a finite set of obstructions in the source structure. Notably, this property precisely characterizes target structures whose homomorphism problem is definable in first-order logic, which is well-known to be decidable over automatic structures. We also consider a natural variant of the problem. While automatic structures are finitely describable, homomorphisms from them into finite structures need not be. This leads to the notion of regular homomorphism, where the homomorphism itself must be describable by finite automata. Remarkably, we prove that this variant exhibits the same dichotomy, with the same characterization for decidability.

AI.title_translation: 关于自动结构的二分性定理
AI.tldr: 自动结构上的同态问题复杂度要么是NL，要么不可判定，可判定性由目标结构的有限对偶性精确刻画；正则同态变体结果相同。
AI.motivation: 研究目标是研究将约束满足问题（CSP）中的同态问题推广到输入为自动结构（潜在无限但可由有限自动机描述的结构）时，这些问题的计算复杂性分类问题。
AI.method: 通过分析自动结构上的同态问题，证明了其复杂度要么属于NL，要么是不可判定的。通过将可判定性与目标结构的“有限对偶性”这一经典性质联系起来，完成了对可判定情况的精确刻画。对于正则同态的变体，采用了相似的方法证明了相同的二分性。
AI.result: 证明了自动结构上的同态问题存在一个显著的二分性：要么是可由非确定性对数空间（NL）决定的，要么是不可判定的。可判定的结构精确地对应于那些具有有限对偶性的结构。正则同态（要求同态本身也是自动的）也具有相同的二分性和相同的可判定性刻画。
AI.conclusion: 对于自动结构上的同态问题，其复杂度要么是可由非确定性对数空间（NL）决定的，要么是不可判定的。可判定的条件精确地等同于目标结构具有有限对偶性。对于“正则同态”的变体，也存在相同的二分性及其相同的可判定性刻画。
AI.translation: 约束满足问题（CSP）研究的是关系结构之间的同态问题，其中目标结构是固定的。对这些问题进行分类是该领域的一个核心追求，尤其是在双方都是有限结构时。在本文中，我们研究了输入的推广，即输入是一个自动结构——一个潜在无限但可由有限自动机描述的结构。我们证明了一个惊人的二分性：关于自动结构的同态问题要么在非确定性对数空间（NL）中可判定，要么是不可判定的。我们证明了问题可判定的结构恰好是那些具有有限对偶性的结构，有限对偶性是目标结构的一个经典性质，断言进入它们的同态性可以由源结构中有限一组障碍物的缺失来表征。值得注意的是，这一性质精确地刻画了其同态问题可以用一阶逻辑定义的那些目标结构，而一阶逻辑在自动结构上可判定是众所周知的。我们还考虑了该问题的一个自然变体。虽然自动结构是有限可描述的，但从它们到有限结构的同态则不一定如此。这引出了正则同态的概念，其中同态本身必须由有限自动机来描述。值得注意的是，我们证明了这个变体也表现出相同的二分性，具有相同的可判定性刻画。
AI.summary: 本文研究了自动结构上的同态问题，证明了其复杂度存在一个二分性：要么在NL内可判定，要么不可判定。可判定性精确对应于目标结构具有有限对偶性的条件。对于要求同态本身是自动的正则同态变体，也得到了相同的二分性结果。
AI.keywords: 自动结构, 同态问题, 约束满足问题, 有限对偶性, NL复杂度
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将自动结构（一类可由有限自动机描述的潜在无限结构）引入到约束满足问题（CSP）的同态问题研究中，并得出了一个强有力的二分性结果（NL或不可判定）。其重要性在于连接了自动结构理论、计算复杂性（NL）和经典结构理论中的对偶性概念。论文的局限性（基于摘要）是未明确讨论自动结构上的具体例子，以及该二分性在更广泛的结构类别中是否成立。

title: Complexity lower bounds for succinct binary structures of bounded clique-width with restrictions
summary: We present a Rice-like complexity lower bound for any MSO-definable problem on binary structures succinctly encoded by circuits. This work extends the framework recently developed as a counterpoint to Courcelle's theorem for graphs encoded by circuits, in two interplaying directions: (1) by allowing multiple binary relations, and (2) by restricting the interpretation of new symbols. Depending on the pair of an MSO problem $ψ$ and an MSO restriction $χ$, the problem is proven to be NP-hard or coNP-hard or P-hard, as long as $ψ$ is non-trivial on structures satisfying $χ$ with bounded clique-width. Indeed, there are P-complete problems (for logspace reductions) in our extended context. Finally, we strengthen a previous result on the necessity to parameterize the notion of non-triviality, hence supporting the choice of clique-width.

AI.title_translation: 有界团宽度限制下简洁二元结构的复杂度下界
AI.tldr: 对于用电路简洁编码的具有多关系和特定限制的有界团宽度二元结构，任何非平凡的MSO问题都具有NP/coNP/P-hard的复杂度下界，扩展了现有框架并支持了团宽度的选择。
AI.motivation: 将最近开发的用于电路编码的图的复杂性下界框架进行扩展，以适应多个二元关系，并限制新符号的解释。
AI.method: 通过扩展最近为电路编码的图开发的框架，针对具有多个二元关系和符号解释限制的二元结构，推导出任何MSO可定义问题的Rice型复杂度下界。
AI.result: 证明了只要$ψ$在满足$χ$且具有有界团宽度的结构上是非平凡的，那么MSO问题$ψ$（受MSO限制$χ$）就是NP-hard、coNP-hard或P-hard的。在扩展的上下文中存在P-完全问题（针对logspace归约）。
AI.conclusion: 我们加强了关于非平凡性概念参数化的先前结果，从而支持了选择团宽度的合理性。
AI.translation: 我们为任何由电路简洁编码的二元结构上的MSO可定义问题提出了一个类似Rice的复杂度下界。这项工作将最近为电路编码的图开发的框架扩展为两个相互关联的方向：(1) 允许多个二元关系，以及 (2) 限制新符号的解释。根据MSO问题$ψ$和MSO限制$χ$的对，只要$ψ$在满足$χ$且具有有界团宽度的结构上是非平凡的，该问题就被证明是NP-hard、coNP-hard或P-hard的。事实上，在我们的扩展上下文中存在P-完全问题（针对logspace归约）。最后，我们加强了先前关于非平凡性概念参数化必要性的结果，从而支持了选择团宽度的选择。
AI.summary: 本文将电路编码的图的复杂度下界框架扩展到具有多个二元关系和符号解释限制的二元结构上，并证明了在这些受限条件下，任何非平凡的MSO可定义问题（在有界团宽度结构上）都是NP-hard、coNP-hard或P-hard的，同时还加强了对非平凡性概念参数化的必要性的论证。
AI.keywords: 复杂度下界, 逻辑电路, 二元结构, 团宽度, MSO逻辑
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地将电路编码的图的复杂性下界框架扩展到了具有多个二元关系和符号解释限制的二元结构上，并证明了在这些受限条件下，某些MSO可定义问题具有NP-hard、coNP-hard或P-hard的复杂度，突显了该框架的重要性。限制条件的选择（如团宽度有界）得到了进一步的理论支持。

title: Hybrid Control of ADT Switched Linear Systems subject to Actuator Saturation
summary: This paper develops a hybrid output-feedback control framework for average dwell-time (ADT) switched linear systems subject to actuator saturation. The considered subsystems may be exponentially unstable, and the saturation nonlinearity is explicitly handled through a deadzone-based representation. The proposed hybrid controller combines mode-dependent full-order dynamic output-feedback controllers with a supervisory reset mechanism that updates controller states at switching instants. By incorporating the reset rule directly into the synthesis conditions, switching boundary constraints and performance requirements are addressed in a unified convex formulation. Sufficient conditions are derived in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) to guarantee exponential stability under ADT switching and a prescribed weighted ${\cal L}_2$-gain disturbance attenuation level for energy-bounded disturbances. An explicit controller construction algorithm is provided based on feasible LMI solutions. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and computational tractability of the proposed approach and highlight its advantages over existing output-feedback saturation control methods.

AI.title_translation: 混合控制在执行器饱和下的ADT切换线性系统
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种混合输出反馈控制框架，用于处理执行器饱和的ADT切换线性系统，即使子系统是指数不稳定的。通过结合依赖模式的动态输出反馈控制器和监督重置机制，并统一在凸优化问题中，该方法能够保证指数稳定性并达到预期的L2增益衰减水平。
AI.motivation: 开发一种混合输出反馈控制框架，用于解决执行器饱和的平均停留时间（ADT）切换线性系统的问题，其中子系统可能指数不稳定。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合输出反馈控制框架，结合了依赖模式的动态输出反馈控制器和监督重置机制，该机制在切换瞬时更新控制器状态。通过将重置规则纳入综合条件，并在凸优化框架下解决了切换边界约束和性能要求。使用线性矩阵不等式（LMIs）推导出保证指数稳定性和L2增益衰减的充分条件，并提供了一个基于可行LMI解的显式控制器构造算法。
AI.result: 推导出了保证指数稳定性和L2增益衰减的充分条件（基于LMI），并提供了一个显式的控制器构造算法。仿真结果表明该方法的有效性、计算效率以及优于现有方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的混合控制框架能够有效地处理执行器饱和的ADT切换线性系统，即使子系统是指数不稳定的，并能保证指数稳定性和L2增益衰减。
AI.translation: 本文针对执行器饱和的平均停留时间（ADT）切换线性系统，开发了一个混合输出反馈控制框架。所考虑的子系统可能是指数不稳定的，并且饱和非线性通过基于死区的表示得到了显式处理。所提出的混合控制器结合了依赖模式的全阶动态输出反馈控制器和一个在切换瞬时更新控制器状态的监督重置机制。通过将重置规则直接纳入综合条件，切换边界约束和性能要求在一个统一的凸公式中得到解决。推导出了关于线性矩阵不等式（LMIs）的充分条件，以保证在ADT切换下的指数稳定性和针对能量有界扰动的规定加权${\cal L}_2$-增益扰动衰减水平。基于可行的LMI解，提供了一个显式的控制器构造算法。仿真结果证明了所提出方法的有效性和计算处理能力，并突出了其相对于现有输出反馈饱和控制方法的优势。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种用于执行器饱和的ADT切换线性系统的混合输出反馈控制方法。该方法结合了动态输出反馈控制器和重置机制，通过LMI在凸优化框架下解决了稳定性与性能问题，并提供了显式的控制器设计算法。仿真结果验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 混合控制,ADT切换线性系统,执行器饱和,输出反馈,线性矩阵不等式
AI.comments: 该研究在处理执行器饱和的切换系统方面取得了进展，特别是对于可能不稳定的子系统。将重置规则整合到凸优化框架中是一个重要的贡献，简化了控制器设计。然而，关于该方法在更复杂或大规模系统中的可扩展性和鲁棒性的进一步研究将是有益的。

title: Neural-HSS: Hierarchical Semi-Separable Neural PDE Solver
summary: Deep learning-based methods have shown remarkable effectiveness in solving PDEs, largely due to their ability to enable fast simulations once trained. However, despite the availability of high-performance computing infrastructure, many critical applications remain constrained by the substantial computational costs associated with generating large-scale, high-quality datasets and training models. In this work, inspired by studies on the structure of Green's functions for elliptic PDEs, we introduce Neural-HSS, a parameter-efficient architecture built upon the Hierarchical Semi-Separable (HSS) matrix structure that is provably data-efficient for a broad class of PDEs. We theoretically analyze the proposed architecture, proving that it satisfies exactness properties even in very low-data regimes. We also investigate its connections with other architectural primitives, such as the Fourier neural operator layer and convolutional layers. We experimentally validate the data efficiency of Neural-HSS on the three-dimensional Poisson equation over a grid of two million points, demonstrating its superior ability to learn from data generated by elliptic PDEs in the low-data regime while outperforming baseline methods. Finally, we demonstrate its capability to learn from data arising from a broad class of PDEs in diverse domains, including electromagnetism, fluid dynamics, and biology.

AI.title_translation: 神经HSS：分层半可分离神经PDE求解器
AI.tldr: Neural-HSS利用HSS矩阵结构构建了一种参数和数据高效的神经PDE求解器，在数据稀疏时表现出色，解决了训练成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 深度学习方法在求解PDE方面表现出色，但生成大规模、高质量数据集和训练模型的计算成本高昂，限制了许多关键应用。研究的动机是引入一种参数高效且数据高效的架构来解决这一约束。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于分层半可分离（HSS）矩阵结构的参数高效架构Neural-HSS，该架构在理论上被证明对一类广泛的PDE具有数据效率。对该架构进行了理论分析，并研究了其与傅里叶神经算子层和卷积层等其他架构原语的联系。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了所提出的架构即使在极低数据量的情况下也能满足精确性属性。在两百万个点的三维泊松方程网格上进行实验验证，证明了Neural-HSS在低数据量下学习椭圆型PDE数据的优越能力，并优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明了Neural-HSS在低数据量情况下学习椭圆型PDEs数据的优越能力，并展示了其在电磁学、流体动力学和生物学等不同领域的PDE数据上的学习能力。
AI.translation: 基于深度学习的方法在求解偏微分方程（PDE）方面显示出卓越的有效性，这主要归功于它们在训练后能够实现快速模拟的能力。然而，尽管高性能计算基础设施可用，许多关键应用仍然受到生成大规模、高质量数据集和训练模型所涉及的巨大计算成本的制约。在这项工作中，我们受到椭圆型PDE格林函数结构研究的启发，引入了Neural-HSS，这是一种基于分层半可分离（HSS）矩阵结构的参数高效架构，该结构对一类广泛的PDE被证明是数据高效的。我们对所提出的架构进行了理论分析，证明即使在极低数据量的情况下，它也能满足精确性属性。我们还研究了它与其他架构原语（如傅里叶神经算子层和卷积层）的联系。我们在两百万个点的三维泊松方程网格上实验验证了Neural-HSS的数据效率，证明了其在低数据量下学习由椭圆型PDE生成的数据的卓越能力，同时优于基线方法。最后，我们展示了它学习来自电磁学、流体动力学和生物学等不同领域的广泛PDE数据的能力。
AI.summary: Neural-HSS是一种参数高效的神经PDE求解器架构，它借鉴了椭圆型PDE格林函数结构的见解，并采用了分层半可分离（HSS）矩阵结构。该架构在理论上被证明对广泛的PDE具有数据效率，即使在数据稀疏的情况下也能保持精确性。实验结果表明，Neural-HSS在低数据量下解决了复杂的三维PDE问题，优于现有方法，并适用于多种物理领域。
AI.keywords: 神经PDE求解器, 分层半可分离矩阵, 参数效率, 数据效率, 椭圆型PDE
AI.comments: 该方法的创新点在于将HSS矩阵结构引入神经网络求解器，以实现参数高效和数据高效。其重要性在于解决了大规模数据生成和模型训练的高昂计算成本问题。局限性在于其理论分析主要集中在椭圆型PDEs上。

title: Dual-Tree LLM-Enhanced Negative Sampling for Implicit Collaborative Filtering
summary:
Negative sampling is a pivotal technique in implicit collaborative filtering (CF) recommendation, enabling efficient and effective training by contrasting observed interactions with sampled unobserved ones.
  Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in recommender systems; however, research on LLM-empowered negative sampling remains underexplored.
  Existing methods heavily rely on textual information and task-specific fine-tuning, limiting practical applicability.
  To address this limitation, we propose a text-free and fine-tuning-free Dual-Tree LLM-enhanced Negative Sampling method (DTL-NS).
  It consists of two modules: (i) an offline false negative identification module that leverages hierarchical index trees to transform collaborative structural and latent semantic information into structured item-ID encodings for LLM inference, enabling accurate identification of false negatives; and (ii) a multi-view hard negative sampling module that combines user-item preference scores with item-item hierarchical similarities from these encodings to mine high-quality hard negatives, thus improving models' discriminative ability.
  Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DTL-NS. For example, on the Amazon-sports dataset, DTL-NS outperforms the strongest baseline by 10.64% and 19.12% in Recall@20 and NDCG@20, respectively.
  Moreover, DTL-NS can be integrated into various implicit CF models and negative sampling methods, consistently enhancing their performance.

AI.title_translation: 双树LLM增强的隐式协同过滤负采样方法
AI.tldr: 为了解决现有LLM负采样依赖文本和微调的问题，我们提出了DTL-NS，它通过将结构和语义信息编码为ID供LLM推理来识别虚假负样本，并挖掘高质量硬负样本，实验证明了其显著的性能提升，且无需文本或微调。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM赋能的负采样方法严重依赖文本信息和特定任务的微调，限制了其实际应用性。研究目标是提出一种无需文本和微调的LLM增强负采样方法。
AI.method: DTL-NS方法包括两个模块：(i) 一个离线的虚假负样本识别模块，利用分层索引树将协作结构和潜在语义信息转化为结构化的物品ID编码以供LLM推理；(ii) 一个多视图硬负样本采样模块，结合用户-物品偏好得分和来自这些编码的物品-物品分层相似度来挖掘高质量的硬负样本。
AI.result: 在Amazon-sports数据集上，DTL-NS在Recall@20和NDCG@20上分别比最强的基线高出10.64%和19.12%。
AI.conclusion: DTL-NS在多个数据集上证明了其有效性，并且可以与各种隐式协同过滤模型和负采样方法集成，持续提升性能。
AI.translation: 负采样是隐式协同过滤（CF）推荐中的一项关键技术，它通过将观察到的交互与采样的未观察交互进行对比，从而实现高效且有效的训练。最近，大型语言模型（LLMs）在推荐系统中显示出潜力；然而，关于LLM赋能的负采样研究仍未充分。现有方法严重依赖文本信息和特定任务的微调，限制了其实际适用性。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了文本无关且无需微调的双树LLM增强负采样方法（DTL-NS）。它包含两个模块：（i）一个离线的虚假负样本识别模块，该模块利用分层索引树将协作结构和潜在语义信息转化为结构化的物品ID编码以供LLM推理，从而能够准确识别虚假负样本；（ii）一个多视图硬负样本采样模块，该模块结合用户-物品偏好得分和来自这些编码的物品-物品分层相似度来挖掘高质量的硬负样本，从而提高模型的区分能力。广泛的实验证明了DTL-NS的有效性。例如，在Amazon-sports数据集上，DTL-NS在Recall@20和NDCG@20上的表现比最强的基线分别高出10.64%和19.12%。此外，DTL-NS可以集成到各种隐式CF模型和负采样方法中，持续提升它们的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为DTL-NS的文本无关且无需微调的双树LLM增强负采样方法，用于隐式协同过滤。它利用分层索引树将结构和语义信息编码为ID，以供LLM识别虚假负样本，并结合偏好得分和层级相似度挖掘硬负样本，以提高模型的区分能力。
AI.keywords: 隐式协同过滤, 负采样, 大语言模型, 双树, 虚假负样本
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地提出了不依赖文本和微调的LLM增强负采样，通过将结构和语义信息编码到ID中进行LLM推理，解决了现有LLM方法对文本和微调的依赖性限制，具有良好的通用性。

title: Variational Distributional Neuron
comments: 29 pages, 7 figures. Code available at GitHub (link in paper)
summary: We propose a proof of concept for a variational distributional neuron: a compute unit formulated as a VAE brick, explicitly carrying a prior, an amortized posterior and a local ELBO. The unit is no longer a deterministic scalar but a distribution: computing is no longer about propagating values, but about contracting a continuous space of possibilities under constraints. Each neuron parameterizes a posterior, propagates a reparameterized sample and is regularized by the KL term of a local ELBO - hence, the activation is distributional. This "contraction" becomes testable through local constraints and can be monitored via internal measures. The amount of contextual information carried by the unit, as well as the temporal persistence of this information, are locally tuned by distinct constraints. This proposal addresses a structural tension: in sequential generation, causality is predominantly organized in the symbolic space and, even when latents exist, they often remain auxiliary, while the effective dynamics are carried by a largely deterministic decoder. In parallel, probabilistic latent models capture factors of variation and uncertainty, but that uncertainty typically remains borne by global or parametric mechanisms, while units continue to propagate scalars - hence the pivot question: if uncertainty is intrinsic to computation, why does the compute unit not carry it explicitly? We therefore draw two axes: (i) the composition of probabilistic constraints, which must be made stable, interpretable and controllable; and (ii) granularity: if inference is a negotiation of distributions under constraints, should the primitive unit remain deterministic or become distributional? We analyze "collapse" modes and the conditions for a "living neuron", then extend the contribution over time via autoregressive priors over the latent, per unit.
comment: 29 pages, 7 figures. Code available at GitHub (link in paper)

AI.tldr: 研究人员提出了一种新的计算单元——变分分布神经元（VDN），它本质上是一个微型VAE，将不确定性（分布）作为其基本输出，而不是一个确定的数值。这旨在解决现有模型中不确定性未被底层计算单元显式处理的问题，通过局部ELBO和约束来管理这种分布计算。
AI.motivation: 解决现有模型中存在的结构性张力：在序列生成中，不确定性通常由全局或参数机制承载，而计算单元（神经元）仍传播确定性标量，而非显式携带固有的不确定性。作者提出的核心问题是：如果计算的内在属性是不确定性，为什么计算单元不明确携带它？
AI.method: 提出变分分布神经元（VDN）的概念模型，该单元被构建为一个VAE的“砖块”，包含先验、近似后验和局部ELBO。通过参数化后验、传播重参数化样本并用局部ELBO的KL项进行正则化来实现分布激活。分析了该单元的局部约束和内部度量，并探讨了稳定概率约束和粒度（计算单元是否应为分布）的两个分析轴。最后，通过在隐变量上设置自回归先验来扩展到时间维度。
AI.result: 证明了变分分布神经元（VDN）的概念可行性，该单元通过局部约束可以测试这种“收缩”过程，并通过内部度量进行监控。确定了不同约束对上下文信息量和时间持续性的局部调节。分析了导致“崩溃”的模式以及维持“活性神经元”的条件。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了变分分布神经元（VDN）的概念，它是一个以VAE为基础的计算单元，明确携带先验、近似后验和局部ELBO。这一设计将计算从值传播转变为在约束下收缩可能性空间，并将不确定性内化到基本计算单元。进一步探讨了稳定概率约束和计算单元粒度的轴线，并分析了“崩溃”模式与“活性神经元”的条件，最后通过自回归先验将贡献扩展到时间维度。
AI.translation: 我们为变分分布神经元：一个被构建为VAE砖块、明确携带先验、一个摊销后验和一个局部证据下界（ELBO）的计算单元，提出了一个概念验证。该单元不再是一个确定性的标量，而是一个分布：计算不再是传播值，而是在约束下收缩一个连续的可能性空间。每个神经元参数化一个后验，传播一个重参数化样本，并受局部ELBO的KL项正则化——因此，激活是分布式的。这种“收缩”可以通过局部约束进行测试，并通过内部度量进行监控。该单元携带的上下文信息的量以及这种信息的暂时持续性，由不同的约束进行局部调整。该提议解决了结构性张力：在序列生成中，因果关系主要在符号空间中组织，即使存在隐变量，它们也常常保持辅助性，而有效的动力学由一个很大程度上是确定的解码器承载。同时，概率隐变量模型捕获了变化的因子和不确定性，但这种不确定性通常由全局或参数机制承担，而单元继续传播标量——因此，关键问题是：如果不确定性是计算的内在属性，为什么计算单元不明确携带它？因此，我们绘制了两条轴：（i）概率约束的组合，必须使其稳定、可解释和可控；（ii）粒度：如果推理是在约束下对分布的协商，那么原始单元应该是确定性的还是分布式的？我们分析了“崩溃”模式和“活性神经元”的条件，然后通过对隐变量的自回归先验将贡献随时间扩展。
AI.summary: 本文提出了变分分布神经元（VDN）的概念验证，它是一个基于VAE结构的计算单元，明确包含先验、近似后验和局部ELBO。VDN将计算从确定性值传播转变为在约束下收缩可能性空间，使激活成为分布，从而将不确定性内化到最小计算单位。研究探讨了概率约束的稳定性和计算单元粒度问题，并讨论了实现“活性神经元”的条件。
AI.keywords: 变分分布神经元, VAE, 概率计算, 证据下界 (ELBO), 粒度
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个新颖的概念——变分分布神经元（VDN），它将变分自编码器（VAE）的结构（先验、近似后验和局部证据下界（ELBO））集成到单个计算单元中。其核心创新在于将计算单元从确定性标量转变为一个分布，从而使不确定性内化到计算的最小单位。这解决了现有模型中不确定性常由全局机制承载而非由基本计算单元显式携带的结构性张力。然而，作为概念验证（proof of concept），其在实际大规模模型中的稳定性和可控性仍有待验证。

title: On the Adversarial Robustness of Discrete Image Tokenizers
summary: Discrete image tokenizers encode visual inputs as sequences of tokens from a finite vocabulary and are gaining popularity in multimodal systems, including encoder-only, encoder-decoder, and decoder-only models. However, unlike CLIP encoders, their vulnerability to adversarial attacks has not been explored. Ours being the first work studying this topic, we first formulate attacks that aim to perturb the features extracted by discrete tokenizers, and thus change the extracted tokens. These attacks are computationally efficient, application-agnostic, and effective across classification, multimodal retrieval, and captioning tasks. Second, to defend against this vulnerability, inspired by recent work on robust CLIP encoders, we fine-tune popular tokenizers with unsupervised adversarial training, keeping all other components frozen. While unsupervised and task-agnostic, our approach significantly improves robustness to both unsupervised and end-to-end supervised attacks and generalizes well to unseen tasks and data. Unlike supervised adversarial training, our approach can leverage unlabeled images, making it more versatile. Overall, our work highlights the critical role of tokenizer robustness in downstream tasks and presents an important step in the development of safe multimodal foundation models.

AI.title_translation: 论离散图像分词器的对抗鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 研究发现流行的离散图像分词器容易受到旨在改变其输出令牌的特征空间攻击，并提出了一种无需标签的对抗训练微调方法来提高其鲁棒性，这对构建安全的多模态基础模型至关重要。
AI.motivation: 离散图像分词器在多模态系统中越来越受欢迎，但与CLIP编码器不同，它们对对抗攻击的脆弱性尚未被探索。
AI.method: 首先，提出旨在扰动离散分词器提取的特征并改变提取出的令牌的攻击方法；其次，受鲁棒CLIP编码器工作的启发，使用无监督对抗训练对流行的分词器进行微调，同时冻结所有其他组件。
AI.result: 提出的攻击方法计算高效、应用无关，并对分类、多模态检索和描述任务有效。无监督、任务无关的微调方法显著提高了对无监督和端到端监督攻击的鲁棒性，并且能很好地泛化到未见过的任务和数据，且能利用未标记图像。
AI.conclusion: 我们的工作突出了分词器鲁棒性在下游任务中的关键作用，并为开发安全的、多模态的基础模型迈出了重要一步。
AI.translation: 离散图像分词器将视觉输入编码为有限词汇表的令牌序列，在包括仅编码器、编码器-解码器和仅解码器模型在内的多模态系统中越来越受欢迎。然而，与CLIP编码器不同，它们对对抗攻击的脆弱性尚未被探索。作为这项研究的第一项工作，我们首先制定了旨在扰动离散分词器提取的特征，从而改变提取出的令牌的攻击方法。这些攻击计算高效、应用无关，并对分类、多模态检索和描述任务有效。其次，为了防御这种脆弱性，受近期关于鲁棒CLIP编码器工作的启发，我们使用无监督对抗训练对流行的分词器进行微调，同时保持所有其他组件冻结。我们的方法虽然是无监督和任务无关的，但显著提高了对无监督和端到端监督攻击的鲁棒性，并能很好地泛化到未见过的任务和数据。与监督对抗训练不同，我们的方法可以利用未标记的图像，使其更通用。总而言之，我们的工作凸显了分词器鲁棒性在下游任务中的关键作用，并为开发安全的、多模态的基础模型迈出了重要一步。
AI.summary: 本研究首次探讨了离散图像分词器对对抗攻击的脆弱性。研究者提出了有效扰动分词器特征以改变输出令牌的攻击方法，并证明了其在各种多模态任务中的有效性。作为防御措施，作者提出了一种使用无监督对抗训练来微调现有分词器的方法，该方法在不依赖监督标签的情况下显著增强了分词器的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 离散图像分词器, 对抗鲁棒性, 对抗攻击, 对抗训练, 多模态系统
AI.comments: 这项工作首次系统地研究了离散图像分词器在对抗鲁棒性方面的漏洞，并提出了一种无需标签的对抗训练防御方法。其创新点在于将攻击目标从传统的像素空间转移到分词器提取的特征空间，并展示了这种脆弱性对多模态任务（如分类、检索和描述）的广泛影响。方法的通用性和无需标签的特性是其重要优势。局限性是需要对现有分词器进行微调，这可能增加计算开销。

title: MEG-to-MEG Transfer Learning and Cross-Task Speech/Silence Detection with Limited Data
comments: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, submitted to Interspeech 2026
summary: Data-efficient neural decoding is a central challenge for speech brain-computer interfaces. We present the first demonstration of transfer learning and cross-task decoding for MEG-based speech models spanning perception and production. We pre-train a Conformer-based model on 50 hours of single-subject listening data and fine-tune on just 5 minutes per subject across 18 participants. Transfer learning yields consistent improvements, with in-task accuracy gains of 1-4% and larger cross-task gains of up to 5-6%. Not only does pre-training improve performance within each task, but it also enables reliable cross-task decoding between perception and production. Critically, models trained on speech production decode passive listening above chance, confirming that learned representations reflect shared neural processes rather than task-specific motor activity.
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, submitted to Interspeech 2026

AI.title_translation: MEG到MEG迁移学习和有限数据的语音/静默检测
AI.tldr: 通过迁移学习，在仅使用5分钟数据的情况下，提高了MEG语音解码的准确性，并实现了跨任务（听觉和说话）的解码。
AI.motivation: 在语音脑机接口中，数据效率低的神经解码是一个核心挑战，尤其是在数据有限的情况下。
AI.method: 使用Conformer模型，在50小时的单被试听觉数据上进行预训练，然后在18名被试的听觉和说话任务上，每人仅用5分钟数据进行微调，以实现迁移学习和跨任务解码。
AI.result: 迁移学习在同一任务中提高了1-4%的准确率，在跨任务解码中提高了5-6%的准确率。预训练模型能够解码被动听觉任务，表明学到的表征反映了共享的神经过程，而非特定于任务的运动活动。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习和跨任务解码是提高数据效率低下的MEG语音解码的有效方法，即使在数据量有限的情况下也能实现可靠的跨任务解码。
AI.translation: 数据效率高的神经解码是语音脑机接口的一个核心挑战。我们首次演示了基于MEG的语音模型在感知和产生任务上的迁移学习和跨任务解码。我们在一名被试的50小时听觉数据上预训练了一个基于Conformer的模型，然后在18名被试的每项任务上仅用5分钟数据进行微调。迁移学习带来了持续的改进，同一任务的准确率提高了1-4%，跨任务的准确率提高了5-6%。预训练不仅提高了每个任务的性能，还实现了感知和产生任务之间可靠的跨任务解码。至关重要的是，在语音产生任务上训练的模型能够解码出高于机会水平的被动听觉，证实了学到的表征反映了共享的神经过程，而不是特定于任务的运动活动。
AI.summary: 本研究首次展示了如何利用迁移学习和跨任务解码技术，在数据量有限的情况下，提升基于MEG的语音脑机接口的性能。研究人员在一个Conformer模型上进行了预训练，然后在听觉和说话任务上进行了微调，结果显示准确率显著提高，并实现了跨感知和产生任务的解码，表明模型学到了共享的神经表征。
AI.keywords: 迁移学习, 脑机接口, MEG, 语音解码, 数据效率
AI.comments: 这项研究在MEG信号处理和脑机接口领域具有重要意义，它解决了数据效率的瓶颈问题，为开发更实用的语音BCI提供了新的途径。然而，研究仅限于18名被试，未来的研究可以扩展到更多样化的人群和更复杂的语音任务。

title: Construction of Cyclic Codes over a Class of Matrix Rings
summary: Let $ \mathbb F_2[u]/ \langle u^k \rangle= \mathbb F_2+u\mathbb F_2+u^2\mathbb F_2+\cdots+u^{k-1}\mathbb F_2 ,$ where $u^k=0$ for a positive integer $k$, and $\mathcal{R}=M_4 (\mathbb F_2( u)/ \langle u^k \rangle)$ be the finite noncommutative non-chain matrix ring of order $4\times4$. This paper presents the construction of cyclic codes over the finite field $\mathbb F_{16}$ via the considered matrix ring $\mathcal{R}$. In this connection, first, we discuss the structure of the ring $\mathcal{R}$ and show that $\mathcal{R}$ is isomorphic to the ring $( \mathbb F_{16}+ v\mathbb F_{16} + v^2\mathbb F_{16} + v^3\mathbb F_{16}) + u(\mathbb F_{16} + v\mathbb F_{16} + v^2\mathbb F_{16} + v^3\mathbb F_{16}) + u^2(\mathbb F_{16} + v\mathbb F_{16} + v^2\mathbb F_{16}+ v^3\mathbb F_{16}) + \cdots + u^{k-1}(\mathbb F_{16} + v\mathbb F_{16} + v^2\mathbb F_{16} + v^3\mathbb F_{16})$ where $v^4=0, u^k=0, u^iv^j=v^ju^i$ for $i \in \{1,\dots, k-1\}$ and $j \in \{1, 2, 3\}$. Then, we establish the form of ideals of the ring $\mathcal{R}$ and related cyclic codes over $\mathcal{R}$. Further, we show that these cyclic codes can be written as the direct sums of $\mathcal{R}$-submodules of $\frac{\mathcal{R}[x]}{<x^n-1>}$, and derive the formula for the cardinality of cyclic codes over $\mathcal{R}$. Then, we consider the Euclidean and Hermitian duals of the derived cyclic codes over $\mathcal{R}$. Under the module isometry for $\mathcal{R}$, we use the Bachoc map and the Gray map, which takes a derived cyclic code over $\mathcal{R}$ to $\mathbb F_{16}$. Finally, we provide some non-trivial examples of linear codes over $\mathbb F_{16}$ with good parameters that support our derived results and compare a few codes with existing codes in the literature.

title: RoEL: Robust Event-based 3D Line Reconstruction
summary: Event cameras in motion tend to detect object boundaries or texture edges, which produce lines of brightness changes, especially in man-made environments. While lines can constitute a robust intermediate representation that is consistently observed, the sparse nature of lines may lead to drastic deterioration with minor estimation errors. Only a few previous works, often accompanied by additional sensors, utilize lines to compensate for the severe domain discrepancies of event sensors along with unpredictable noise characteristics. We propose a method that can stably extract tracks of varying appearances of lines using a clever algorithmic process that observes multiple representations from various time slices of events, compensating for potential adversaries within the event data. We then propose geometric cost functions that can refine the 3D line maps and camera poses, eliminating projective distortions and depth ambiguities. The 3D line maps are highly compact and can be equipped with our proposed cost function, which can be adapted for any observations that can detect and extract line structures or projections of them, including 3D point cloud maps or image observations. We demonstrate that our formulation is powerful enough to exhibit a significant performance boost in event-based mapping and pose refinement across diverse datasets, and can be flexibly applied to multimodal scenarios. Our results confirm that the proposed line-based formulation is a robust and effective approach for the practical deployment of event-based perceptual modules. Project page: https://gwangtak.github.io/roel/

title: Role-Adaptive Collaborative Formation Planning for Team of Quadruped Robots in Cluttered Environments
summary: This paper presents a role-adaptive Leader-Follower-based formation planning and control framework for teams of quadruped robots operating in cluttered environments. Unlike conventional methods with fixed leaders or rigid formation roles, the proposed approach integrates dynamic role assignment and partial goal planning, enabling flexible, collision-free navigation in complex scenarios. Formation stability and inter-robot safety are ensured through a virtual spring-damper system coupled with a novel obstacle avoidance layer that adaptively adjusts each agent's velocity. A dynamic look-ahead reference generator further enhances flexibility, allowing temporary formation deformation to maneuver around obstacles while maintaining goal-directed motion. The Fast Marching Square (FM2) algorithm provides the global path for the leader and local paths for the followers as the planning backbone. The framework is validated through extensive simulations and real-world experiments with teams of quadruped robots. Results demonstrate smooth coordination, adaptive role switching, and robust formation maintenance in complex, unstructured environments. A video featuring the simulation and physical experiments along with their associated visualizations can be found at https://youtu.be/scq37Tua9W4.

title: Accurate Data-Based State Estimation from Power Loads Inference in Electric Power Grids
summary: Accurate state estimation is a crucial requirement for the reliable operation and control of electric power systems. Here, we construct a data-driven, numerical method to infer missing power load values in large-scale power grids. Given partial observations of power demands, the method estimates the operational state using a linear regression algorithm, exploiting statistical correlations within synthetic training datasets. We evaluate the performance of the method on three synthetic transmission grid test systems. Numerical experiments demonstrate the high accuracy achieved by the method in reconstructing missing demand values under various operating conditions. We further apply the method to real data for the transmission power grid of Switzerland. Despite the restricted number of observations in this dataset, the method infers missing power loads rather accurately. Furthermore, Newton-Raphson power flow solutions show that deviations between true and inferred values for power loads result in smaller deviations between true and inferred values for flows on power lines. This ensures that the estimated operational state correctly captures potential line contingencies. Overall, our results indicate that simple data-based regression techniques can provide an efficient and reliable alternative for state estimation in modern power grids.

title: Simplifying Outcomes of Language Model Component Analyses with ELIA
summary: While mechanistic interpretability has developed powerful tools to analyze the internal workings of Large Language Models (LLMs), their complexity has created an accessibility gap, limiting their use to specialists. We address this challenge by designing, building, and evaluating ELIA (Explainable Language Interpretability Analysis), an interactive web application that simplifies the outcomes of various language model component analyses for a broader audience. The system integrates three key techniques -- Attribution Analysis, Function Vector Analysis, and Circuit Tracing -- and introduces a novel methodology: using a vision-language model to automatically generate natural language explanations (NLEs) for the complex visualizations produced by these methods. The effectiveness of this approach was empirically validated through a mixed-methods user study, which revealed a clear preference for interactive, explorable interfaces over simpler, static visualizations. A key finding was that the AI-powered explanations helped bridge the knowledge gap for non-experts; a statistical analysis showed no significant correlation between a user's prior LLM experience and their comprehension scores, suggesting that the system reduced barriers to comprehension across experience levels. We conclude that an AI system can indeed simplify complex model analyses, but its true power is unlocked when paired with thoughtful, user-centered design that prioritizes interactivity, specificity, and narrative guidance.

title: A Curated Literature Database for Monitoring More Than 30 Years of Ansys Granta Product Usage
summary: Engineering and materials software is increasingly difficult to track in the scholarly and technical literature because publication volume is growing rapidly and software citation practices remain inconsistent. This is particularly true for the Ansys Granta product family, which is used for materials education, materials and process selection, sustainability-driven design, and enterprise materials information management. We present a structured and reproducible framework to consolidate evidence of \emph{operational} Granta usage and to support quantitative monitoring of adoption patterns, application domains, and technical impact. The framework is implemented as a curated reference database in \textit{Ansys Granta MI Enterprise}: bibliographic metadata are ingested semi-automatically (e.g., via DOI and citation-file parsing) and complemented by expert curation of usage descriptors (product, context, application domain, and technical depth), with relational links to authors and institutions. Downstream analytics are performed with Python, dashboards, and bibliometric/network visualization tools to enable reproducible querying and reporting. As of September~2025, the database contains more than 1{,}100 curated records spanning journals, conferences, theses, books, patents, standards, and reports, and supports rapid retrieval of validated case studies, reproducible literature reviews, and technology scouting. Example analyses highlight dominant domains, key institutions, and recurring integrations with CAD/CAE/FEM environments. Overall, the approach converts heterogeneous software-usage evidence into structured, analyzable knowledge to improve visibility of engineering software impact and to support evidence-based assessment and strategic decision-making.

title: A Probabilistic Framework for LLM-Based Model Discovery
summary: Automated methods for discovering mechanistic simulator models from observational data offer a promising path toward accelerating scientific progress. Such methods often take the form of agentic-style iterative workflows that repeatedly propose and revise candidate models by imitating human discovery processes. However, existing LLM-based approaches typically implement such workflows via hand-crafted heuristic procedures, without an explicit probabilistic formulation. We recast model discovery as probabilistic inference, i.e., as sampling from an unknown distribution over mechanistic models capable of explaining the data. This perspective provides a unified way to reason about model proposal, refinement, and selection within a single inference framework. As a concrete instantiation of this view, we introduce ModelSMC, an algorithm based on Sequential Monte Carlo sampling. ModelSMC represents candidate models as particles which are iteratively proposed and refined by an LLM, and weighted using likelihood-based criteria. Experiments on real-world scientific systems illustrate that this formulation discovers models with interpretable mechanisms and improves posterior predictive checks. More broadly, this perspective provides a probabilistic lens for understanding and developing LLM-based approaches to model discovery.

title: Many Tools, Few Exploitable Vulnerabilities: A Survey of 246 Static Code Analyzers for Security
summary: Static security analysis is a widely used technique for detecting software vulnerabilities across a wide range of weaknesses, application domains, and programming languages. While prior work surveyed static analyzes for specific weaknesses or application domains, no overview of the entire security landscape exists. We present a systematic literature review of 246 static security analyzers concerning their targeted vulnerabilities, application domains, analysis techniques, evaluation methods, and limitations. We observe that most analyzers focus on a limited set of weaknesses, that the vulnerabilities they detect are rarely exploitable, and that evaluations use custom benchmarks that are too small to enable robust assessment.

title: Seasoning Data Modeling Education with GARLIC: A Participatory Co-Design Framework
comments: DataEd'26: 5th International Workshop on Data Systems Education
summary:
Entity-Relationship (ER) modeling is commonly taught as a primarily technical activity, despite its central role in shaping how data systems represent people, processes, and institutions. Prior research in participatory design demonstrates that involving diverse stakeholders in modeling can surface tacit knowledge, challenge implicit assumptions, and produce more inclusive data representations. However, database education currently lacks structured pedagogical approaches for teaching participatory ER modeling in practice.
  We introduce the GARLIC methodology for teaching and learning participatory ER modeling. GARLIC adapts and extends the ONION participatory ER modeling framework of Makovska et al.(HILDA 2025) into a workshop-based learning format that combines role-playing, collaborative synthesis, guided critique, and iterative refinement. GARLIC is designed to develop both technical modeling skills and critical awareness of the social and ethical dimensions of data representation. GARLIC lowers the barrier to participatory ER modeling and equips students with practical skills for collaborative, inclusive data model design.
comment: DataEd'26: 5th International Workshop on Data Systems Education

title: PRISM: Parallel Reward Integration with Symmetry for MORL
summary: This work studies heterogeneous Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL), where objectives can differ sharply in temporal frequency. Such heterogeneity allows dense objectives to dominate learning, while sparse long-horizon rewards receive weak credit assignment, leading to poor sample efficiency. We propose a Parallel Reward Integration with Symmetry (PRISM) algorithm that enforces reflectional symmetry as an inductive bias in aligning reward channels. PRISM introduces ReSymNet, a theory-motivated model that reconciles temporal-frequency mismatches across objectives, using residual blocks to learn a scaled opportunity value that accelerates exploration while preserving the optimal policy. We also propose SymReg, a reflectional equivariance regulariser that enforces agent mirroring and constrains policy search to a reflection-equivariant subspace. This restriction provably reduces hypothesis complexity and improves generalisation. Across MuJoCo benchmarks, PRISM consistently outperforms both a sparse-reward baseline and an oracle trained with full dense rewards, improving Pareto coverage and distributional balance: it achieves hypervolume gains exceeding 100\% over the baseline and up to 32\% over the oracle. The code is at \href{https://github.com/EVIEHub/PRISM}{https://github.com/EVIEHub/PRISM}.

title: DEIG: Detail-Enhanced Instance Generation with Fine-Grained Semantic Control
summary: Multi-Instance Generation has advanced significantly in spatial placement and attribute binding. However, existing approaches still face challenges in fine-grained semantic understanding, particularly when dealing with complex textual descriptions. To overcome these limitations, we propose DEIG, a novel framework for fine-grained and controllable multi-instance generation. DEIG integrates an Instance Detail Extractor (IDE) that transforms text encoder embeddings into compact, instance-aware representations, and a Detail Fusion Module (DFM) that applies instance-based masked attention to prevent attribute leakage across instances. These components enable DEIG to generate visually coherent multi-instance scenes that precisely match rich, localized textual descriptions. To support fine-grained supervision, we construct a high-quality dataset with detailed, compositional instance captions generated by VLMs. We also introduce DEIG-Bench, a new benchmark with region-level annotations and multi-attribute prompts for both humans and objects. Experiments demonstrate that DEIG consistently outperforms existing approaches across multiple benchmarks in spatial consistency, semantic accuracy, and compositional generalization. Moreover, DEIG functions as a plug-and-play module, making it easily integrable into standard diffusion-based pipelines.

title: HyTRec: A Hybrid Temporal-Aware Attention Architecture for Long Behavior Sequential Recommendation
summary: Modeling long sequences of user behaviors has emerged as a critical frontier in generative recommendation. However, existing solutions face a dilemma: linear attention mechanisms achieve efficiency at the cost of retrieval precision due to limited state capacity, while softmax attention suffers from prohibitive computational overhead. To address this challenge, we propose HyTRec, a model featuring a Hybrid Attention architecture that explicitly decouples long-term stable preferences from short-term intent spikes. By assigning massive historical sequences to a linear attention branch and reserving a specialized softmax attention branch for recent interactions, our approach restores precise retrieval capabilities within industrial-scale contexts involving ten thousand interactions. To mitigate the lag in capturing rapid interest drifts within the linear layers, we furthermore design Temporal-Aware Delta Network (TADN) to dynamically upweight fresh behavioral signals while effectively suppressing historical noise. Empirical results on industrial-scale datasets confirm the superiority that our model maintains linear inference speed and outperforms strong baselines, notably delivering over 8% improvement in Hit Rate for users with ultra-long sequences with great efficiency.

title: Detecting PowerShell-based Fileless Cryptojacking Attacks Using Machine Learning
summary: With the emergence of remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities in ubiquitous libraries and advanced social engineering techniques, threat actors have started conducting widespread fileless cryptojacking attacks. These attacks have become effective with stealthy techniques based on PowerShell-based exploitation in Windows OS environments. Even if attacks are detected and malicious scripts removed, processes may remain operational on victim endpoints, creating a significant challenge for detection mechanisms. In this paper, we conducted an experimental study with a collected dataset on detecting PowerShell-based fileless cryptojacking scripts. The results showed that Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-based fine-tuned CodeBERT achieved a high recall rate, proving the importance of the use of AST integration and fine-tuned pre-trained models for programming language.

title: Green by Design: Constraint-Based Adaptive Deployment in the Cloud Continuum
summary: The environmental sustainability of Information Technology (IT) has emerged as a critical concern, driven by the need to reduce both energy consumption and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. In the context of cloud-native applications deployed across the cloud-edge continuum, this challenge translates into identifying energy-efficient deployment strategies that consider not only the computational demands of application components but also the environmental impact of the nodes on which they are executed. Generating deployment plans that account for these dynamic factors is non-trivial, due to fluctuations in application behaviour and variations in the carbon intensity of infrastructure nodes. In this paper, we present an approach for the automatic generation of deployment plans guided by green constraints. These constraints are derived from a continuous analysis of energy consumption patterns, inter-component communication, and the environmental characteristics of the underlying infrastructure. This paper introduces a methodology and architecture for the generation of a set of green-aware constraints that inform the scheduler to produce environmentally friendly deployment plans. We demonstrate how these constraints can be automatically learned and updated over time using monitoring data, enabling adaptive, energy-aware orchestration. The proposed approach is validated through realistic deployment scenarios of a cloud-native application, showcasing its effectiveness in reducing energy usage and associated emissions.

title: A Topology-Aware Positive Sample Set Construction and Feature Optimization Method in Implicit Collaborative Filtering
summary: Negative sampling strategies are widely used in implicit collaborative filtering to address issues like data sparsity and class imbalance. However, these methods often introduce false negatives, hindering the model's ability to accurately learn users' latent preferences. To mitigate this problem, existing methods adjust the negative sampling distribution based on statistical features from model training or the hardness of negative samples. Nevertheless, these methods face two key limitations: (1) over-reliance on the model's current representation capabilities; (2) failure to leverage the potential of false negatives as latent positive samples to guide model learning of user preferences more accurately. To address the above issues, we propose a Topology-aware Positive Sample Set Construction and Feature Optimization method (TPSC-FO). First, we design a simple topological community-aware false negative identification (FNI) method and observe that topological community structures in interaction networks can effectively identify false negatives. Motivated by this, we develop a topology-aware positive sample set construction module. This module employs a differential community detection strategy to capture topological community structures in implicit feedback, coupled with personalized noise filtration to reliably identify false negatives and convert them into positive samples. Additionally, we introduce a neighborhood-guided feature optimization module that refines positive sample features by incorporating neighborhood features in the embedding space, effectively mitigating noise in the positive samples. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets and two synthetic datasets validate the effectiveness of TPSC-FO.

title: Diffusing to Coordinate: Efficient Online Multi-Agent Diffusion Policies
summary: Online Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a prominent framework for efficient agent coordination. Crucially, enhancing policy expressiveness is pivotal for achieving superior performance. Diffusion-based generative models are well-positioned to meet this demand, having demonstrated remarkable expressiveness and multimodal representation in image generation and offline settings. Yet, their potential in online MARL remains largely under-explored. A major obstacle is that the intractable likelihoods of diffusion models impede entropy-based exploration and coordination. To tackle this challenge, we propose among the first \underline{O}nline off-policy \underline{MA}RL framework using \underline{D}iffusion policies (\textbf{OMAD}) to orchestrate coordination. Our key innovation is a relaxed policy objective that maximizes scaled joint entropy, facilitating effective exploration without relying on tractable likelihood. Complementing this, within the centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) paradigm, we employ a joint distributional value function to optimize decentralized diffusion policies. It leverages tractable entropy-augmented targets to guide the simultaneous updates of diffusion policies, thereby ensuring stable coordination. Extensive evaluations on MPE and MAMuJoCo establish our method as the new state-of-the-art across $10$ diverse tasks, demonstrating a remarkable $2.5\times$ to $5\times$ improvement in sample efficiency.

title: Decoding as Optimisation on the Probability Simplex: From Top-K to Top-P (Nucleus) to Best-of-K Samplers
summary: Decoding sits between a language model and everything we do with it, yet it is still treated as a heuristic knob-tuning exercise. We argue decoding should be understood as a principled optimisation layer: at each token, we solve a regularised problem over the probability simplex that trades off model score against structural preferences and constraints. This single template recovers greedy decoding, Softmax sampling, Top-K, Top-P, and Sparsemax-style sparsity as special cases, and explains their common structure through optimality conditions. More importantly, the framework makes it easy to invent new decoders without folklore. We demonstrate this by designing Best-of-K (BoK), a KL-anchored coverage objective aimed at multi-sample pipelines (self-consistency, reranking, verifier selection). BoK targets the probability of covering good alternatives within a fixed K-sample budget and improves empirical performance. We show that such samples can improve accuracy by, for example, +18.6% for Qwen2.5-Math-7B on MATH500 at high sampling temperatures.

title: Towards a Higher-Order Bialgebraic Denotational Semantics
summary: The bialgebraic abstract GSOS framework by Turi and Plotkin provides an elegant categorical approach to modelling the operational and denotational semantics of programming and process languages. In abstract GSOS, bisimilarity is always a congruence, and it coincides with denotational equivalence. This saves the language designer from intricate, ad-hoc reasoning to establish these properties. The bialgebraic perspective on operational semantics in the style of abstract GSOS has recently been extended to higher-order languages, preserving compositionality of bisimilarity. However, a categorical understanding of bialgebraic denotational semantics according to Turi and Plotkin's original vision has so far been missing in the higher-order setting. In the present paper, we develop a theory of adequate denotational semantics in higher-order abstract GSOS. The denotational models are parametric in an appropriately chosen semantic domain in the form of a locally final coalgebra for a behaviour bifunctor, whose construction is fully decoupled from the syntax of the language. Our approach captures existing accounts of denotational semantics such as semantic domains built via general step-indexing, previously introduced on a per-language basis, and is shown to be applicable to a wide range of different higher-order languages, e.g. simply typed and untyped languages, or languages with computational effects such as probabilistic or non-deterministic branching.

title: Context-Aware Mapping of 2D Drawing Annotations to 3D CAD Features Using LLM-Assisted Reasoning for Manufacturing Automation
summary: Manufacturing automation in process planning, inspection planning, and digital-thread integration depends on a unified specification that binds the geometric features of a 3D CAD model to the geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) callouts, datum definitions, and surface requirements carried by the corresponding 2D engineering drawing. Although Model-Based Definition (MBD) allows such specifications to be embedded directly in 3D models, 2D drawings remain the primary carrier of manufacturing intent in automotive, aerospace, shipbuilding, and heavy-machinery industries. Correctly linking drawing annotations to the corresponding 3D features is difficult because of contextual ambiguity, repeated feature patterns, and the need for transparent and traceable decisions. This paper presents a deterministic-first, context-aware framework that maps 2D drawing entities to 3D CAD features to produce a unified manufacturing specification. Drawing callouts are first semantically enriched and then scored against candidate features using an interpretable metric that combines type compatibility, tolerance-aware dimensional agreement, and conservative context consistency, along with engineering-domain heuristics. When deterministic scoring cannot resolve an ambiguity, the system escalates to multimodal and constrained large-language-model reasoning, followed by a single human-in-the-loop (HITL) review step. Experiments on 20 real CAD-drawing pairs achieve a mean precision of 83.67%, recall of 90.46%, and F1 score of 86.29%. An ablation study shows that each pipeline component contributes to overall accuracy, with the full system outperforming all reduced variants. By prioritizing deterministic rules, clear decision tracking, and retaining unresolved cases for human review, the framework provides a practical foundation for downstream manufacturing automation in real-world industrial environments.

title: Analyzing and Improving Chain-of-Thought Monitorability Through Information Theory
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitors are LLM-based systems that analyze reasoning traces to detect when outputs may exhibit attributes of interest, such as test-hacking behavior during code generation. In this paper, we use information-theoretic analysis to show that non-zero mutual information between CoT and output is a necessary but not sufficient condition for CoT monitorability. We identify two sources of approximation error that may undermine the performance of CoT monitors in practice: information gap, which measures the extent to which the monitor can extract the information available in CoT, and elicitation error, which measures the extent to which the monitor approximates the optimal monitoring function. We further demonstrate that CoT monitorability can be systematically improved through targeted training objectives. To this end, we propose two complementary approaches: (a) an oracle-based method that directly rewards the monitored model for producing CoTs that maximize monitor accuracy, and (b) a more practical, label-free approach that maximizes conditional mutual information between outputs and CoTs. Across multiple different environments, we show both methods significantly improve monitor accuracy while preventing CoT degeneration even when training against a monitor, thereby mitigating reward hacking when the task reward is imperfectly specified.

title: On the Semantic and Syntactic Information Encoded in Proto-Tokens for One-Step Text Reconstruction
summary: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) generate text token-by-token, requiring n forward passes to produce a sequence of length n. Recent work, Exploring the Latent Capacity of LLMs for One-Step Text Reconstruction (Mezentsev and Oseledets), shows that frozen LLMs can reconstruct hundreds of tokens from only two learned proto-tokens in a single forward pass, suggesting a path beyond the autoregressive paradigm. In this paper, we study what information these proto-tokens encode and how they behave under reconstruction and controlled constraints. We perform a series of experiments aimed at disentangling semantic and syntactic content in the two proto-tokens, analyzing stability properties of the e-token, and visualizing attention patterns to the e-token during reconstruction. Finally, we test two regularization schemes for "imposing" semantic structure on the e-token using teacher embeddings, including an anchor-based loss and a relational distillation objective. Our results indicate that the m-token tends to capture semantic information more strongly than the e-token under standard optimization; anchor-based constraints trade off sharply with reconstruction accuracy; and relational distillation can transfer batch-level semantic relations into the proto-token space without sacrificing reconstruction quality, supporting the feasibility of future non-autoregressive seq2seq systems that predict proto-tokens as an intermediate representation.

title: FeatureBleed: Inferring Private Enriched Attributes From Sparsity-Optimized AI Accelerators
comments: 4 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, Journal :- IEEE CAL
summary:
Backend enrichment is now widely deployed in sensitive domains such as product recommendation pipelines, healthcare, and finance, where models are trained on confidential data and retrieve private features whose values influence inference behavior while remaining hidden from the API caller. This paper presents the first hardware-level backend retrieval data-stealing attack, showing that accelerator optimizations designed for performance can directly undermine data confidentiality and bypass state-of-the-art privacy defenses.
  Our attack, FEATUREBLEED, exploits zero-skipping in AI accelerators to infer private backend-retrieved features solely through end-to-end timing, without relying on power analysis, DVFS manipulation, or shared-cache side channels. We evaluate FEATUREBLEED on three datasets spanning medical and non-medical domains: Texas-100X (clinical records), OrganAMNIST (medical imaging), and Census-19 (socioeconomic data). We further evaluate FEATUREBLEED across three hardware backends (Intel AVX, Intel AMX, and NVIDIA A100) and three model architectures (DNNs, CNNs, and hybrid CNN-MLP pipelines), demonstrating that the leakage generalizes across CPU and GPU accelerators, data modalities, and application domains, with an adversarial advantage of up to 98.87 percentage points.
  Finally, we identify the root cause of the leakage as sparsity-driven zero-skipping in modern hardware. We quantify the privacy-performance-power trade-off: disabling zero-skipping increases Intel AMX per-operation energy by up to 25 percent and incurs 100 percent performance overhead. We propose a padding-based defense that masks timing leakage by equalizing responses to the worst-case execution time, achieving protection with only 7.24 percent average performance overhead and no additional power cost.
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, Journal :- IEEE CAL

title: On A. V. Anisimov's problem for finding a polynomial algorithm checking inclusion of context-free languages in group languages
summary: The work investigates the problem of whether a context-free language is a subset of a group language. A.~V. Anisimov has shown that the problem of determining the unambiguity of finite automata is a special case of this problem. Then the question of finding polynomial algorithm verifying the inclusion of context-free languages in group languages naturally arises. The article focuses on this open problem. For the purpose, the paper describes an unconventional method of description of context-free languages, namely a representation with the help of a finite digraph whose arcs are labelled with a specially defined monoid $\mathcal{U}$. Also, we define a semiring $\mathcal{S}_\mathcal{U}$ whose elements are the set $2^\mathcal{U}$ of all subsets of $\mathcal{U}$ and with operations - product and union of the elements of $2^\mathcal{U}$. The described algorithm executes no more than $O(n^3)$ operations in $\mathcal{S}_\mathcal{U}$.

title: ReqElicitGym: An Evaluation Environment for Interview Competence in Conversational Requirements Elicitation
summary: With the rapid improvement of LLMs' coding capabilities, the bottleneck of LLM-based automated software development is shifting from generating correct code to eliciting users' requirements. Despite growing interest, the interview competence of LLMs in conversational requirements elicitation remains fully underexplored. Existing evaluations often depend on a few scenarios, real user interaction, and subjective human scoring, which hinders systematic and quantitative comparison. To address these challenges, we propose ReqElicitGym, an interactive and automatic evaluation environment for assessing interview competence in conversational requirements elicitation. Specifically, ReqElicitGym introduces a new evaluation dataset and designs both an interactive oracle user and a task evaluator. The dataset contains 101 website requirements elicitation scenarios spanning 10 application types. Both the oracle user and the task evaluator achieve high agreement with real users and expert judgment. Using our ReqElicitGym, any automated conversational requirements elicitation approach (e.g., LLM-based agents) can be evaluated in a reproducible and quantitative manner through interaction with the environment. Based on our ReqElicitGym, we conduct a systematic empirical study on seven representative LLMs, and the results show that current LLMs still exhibit limited interview competence in uncovering implicit requirements. Particularly, they elicit less than half of the users' implicit requirements, and their effective elicitation questions often emerge in later turns of the dialogue. Besides, we found LLMs can elicit interaction and content implicit requirements, but consistently struggle with style-related requirements. We believe ReqElicitGym will facilitate the evaluation and development of automated conversational requirements elicitation.

AI.title_translation: 需求诱导体操：对话式需求诱导中面试能力的评估环境
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了ReqElicitGym，一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在对话式需求获取中面试能力的自动化环境，并发现现有LLM在此方面能力有限。
AI.motivation: 现有评估LLM在对话式需求获取中面试能力的方法存在局限性，如依赖少数场景、真实用户交互和主观评分，阻碍了系统性和定量比较。
AI.method: 提出ReqElicitGym，一个包含101个网站需求获取场景的新数据集，并设计了一个交互式“神谕用户”和一个任务评估器，用于自动化和可重复地评估面试能力。
AI.result: 在七个代表性LLM上的实证研究表明，当前LLM在挖掘隐性需求方面能力有限，仅能获取不到一半的隐性需求，且有效问题多出现在对话后期。LLM能获取交互和内容方面的隐性需求，但在风格方面存在困难。
AI.conclusion: ReqElicitGym为自动化对话式需求获取的评估和开发提供了支持，并揭示了当前LLM在面试能力方面的不足。
AI.translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）编码能力的快速提升，基于LLM的自动化软件开发的瓶颈正从生成正确代码转向获取用户需求。尽管人们对此越来越感兴趣，但LLM在对话式需求获取中的面试能力仍未得到充分探索。现有的评估通常依赖于少数场景、真实用户交互和主观人工评分，这阻碍了系统性和定量的比较。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ReqElicitGym，一个用于评估对话式需求获取中面试能力的交互式和自动化评估环境。具体来说，ReqElicitGym引入了一个新的评估数据集，并设计了一个交互式“神谕用户”和一个任务评估器。“神谕用户”和任务评估器均与真实用户和专家判断高度一致。利用我们的ReqElicitGym，任何自动化对话式需求获取方法（例如，基于LLM的代理）都可以通过与环境的交互，以可重复和定量的方式进行评估。基于我们的ReqElicitGym，我们对七个代表性LLM进行了系统的实证研究，结果表明当前LLM在挖掘隐性需求方面的面试能力仍然有限。特别是，它们挖掘的用户隐性需求不到一半，并且有效的挖掘问题通常出现在对话的后期。此外，我们发现LLM可以挖掘交互式和内容方面的隐性需求，但在风格相关的需求方面一直存在困难。我们相信ReqElicitGym将促进自动化对话式需求获取的评估和开发。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了ReqElicitGym，一个创新的自动化评估环境，用于量化和系统地评估大型语言模型（LLM）在对话式需求获取中的面试能力。该环境包含一个包含101个场景的新数据集、一个模拟用户的“神谕用户”和一个任务评估器。通过在七个LLM上的实验，研究发现当前LLM在挖掘隐性需求方面存在显著不足，尤其是在对话后期和风格需求方面。
AI.keywords: 对话式需求获取, LLM面试能力, 自动化评估, ReqElicitGym, 隐性需求
AI.comments: ReqElicitGym的提出解决了现有评估方法的主观性和局限性问题，为LLM在需求工程领域的应用提供了重要的量化评估工具。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索如何提高LLM在挖掘隐性需求，特别是风格需求方面的能力。

title: VeriSoftBench: Repository-Scale Formal Verification Benchmarks for Lean
summary: Large language models have achieved striking results in interactive theorem proving, particularly in Lean. However, most benchmarks for LLM-based proof automation are drawn from mathematics in the Mathlib ecosystem, whereas proofs in software verification are developed inside definition-rich codebases with substantial project-specific libraries. We introduce VeriSoftBench, a benchmark of 500 Lean 4 proof obligations drawn from open-source formal-methods developments and packaged to preserve realistic repository context and cross-file dependencies. Our evaluation of frontier LLMs and specialized provers yields three observations. First, provers tuned for Mathlib-style mathematics transfer poorly to this repository-centric setting. Second, success is strongly correlated with transitive repository dependence: tasks whose proofs draw on large, multi-hop dependency closures are less likely to be solved. Third, providing curated context restricted to a proof's dependency closure improves performance relative to exposing the full repository, but nevertheless leaves substantial room for improvement. Our benchmark and evaluation suite are released at https://github.com/utopia-group/VeriSoftBench.

AI.title_translation: VeriSoftBench：面向Lean的仓库级形式化验证基准
AI.tldr: 研究人员发布了VeriSoftBench，一个包含500个来自真实软件项目、保留依赖关系的Lean 4证明义务基准，用于测试大型语言模型和证明器在软件形式化验证中的性能。结果表明，现有工具在处理这种仓库依赖场景时效果不佳，并且依赖的复杂性是主要的性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的证明自动化基准主要来自Mathlib生态系统的数学内容，而软件验证中的证明是在具有大量特定项目库的、定义丰富的代码库中开发的，因此需要针对这种软件验证场景的基准。
AI.method: 引入了VeriSoftBench，一个包含500个来自开源形式化方法开发的Lean 4证明义务的基准，并设计用于保留真实的仓库上下文和跨文件依赖。然后，使用前沿的LLM和专业证明器对该基准进行了评估。
AI.result: 评估得出三点发现：1. 针对Mathlib风格数学调优的证明器在仓库中心设置中转移效果不佳。2. 成功率与传递性仓库依赖性强相关：依赖大型、多跳依赖闭包的任务解决率较低。3. 相比于暴露整个仓库，提供受限于证明依赖闭包的精选上下文可以提高性能，但仍有很大改进空间。
AI.conclusion: （未在摘要中明确给出总结性结论，但评估结果暗示需要开发更适合处理复杂代码库依赖的自动化证明工具。）
AI.translation: 大型语言模型在交互式定理证明中取得了惊人的成果，尤其是在Lean中。然而，大多数基于LLM的证明自动化基准是从Mathlib生态系统中的数学中提取的，而软件验证中的证明是在具有大量特定项目库的、定义丰富的代码库中开发的。我们引入了VeriSoftBench，这是一个包含500个取自开源形式化方法开发的Lean 4证明义务的基准，并进行打包以保留真实的仓库上下文和跨文件依赖。我们对前沿LLM和专业证明器的评估得出了三个观察结果。第一，为Mathlib风格数学调优的证明器在此仓库中心设置中转移效果不佳。第二，成功率与传递性仓库依赖性强相关：其证明依赖于大型、多跳依赖闭包的任务不太可能被解决。第三，提供受限于证明依赖闭包的精选上下文相对于暴露整个仓库可以提高性能，但仍有大量的改进空间。我们的基准和评估套件已在https://github.com/utopia-group/VeriSoftBench发布。
AI.summary: VeriSoftBench是一个包含500个来自开源软件形式化方法开发的Lean 4证明义务的基准，旨在解决现有基准侧重于Mathlib而缺乏软件仓库背景依赖的问题。评估结果显示，现有工具在处理这种具有复杂依赖的代码库场景时表现不佳，且依赖深度是成功的关键阻碍因素。
AI.keywords: Lean 4,形式化验证,基准测试,LLM,软件验证
AI.comments: 这项工作的重要性在于它首次为基于LLM的软件形式化验证自动化提供了一个规模化、贴近实际代码库依赖的基准，填补了现有主要侧重于数学库Mathlib的空白。其创新点在于构建了保留了真实仓库上下文和跨文件依赖的500个证明义务。局限性在于，即使提供了受限的上下文，当前前沿模型和证明器的性能仍有很大提升空间。

title: JPmHC Dynamical Isometry via Orthogonal Hyper-Connections
summary: Recent advances in deep learning, exemplified by Hyper-Connections (HC), have expanded the residual connection paradigm by introducing wider residual streams and diverse connectivity patterns. While these innovations yield significant performance gains, they compromise the identity mapping property of residual connections, leading to training instability, limited scalability, and increased memory overhead. To address these challenges, we propose JPmHC (Jacobian-spectrum Preserving manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections), a framework that replaces identity skips with a trainable linear mixer acting on n parallel streams while explicitly controlling gradient conditioning. By constraining the mixer M on operator-norm-bounded manifolds (e.g., bistochastic, Stiefel, Grassmann), JPmHC prevents gradient pathologies and enhances stability. JPmHC introduces three key contributions: (i) a free-probability analysis that predicts Jacobian spectra for structured skips, providing actionable design rules for mixer selection; (ii) memory-efficient implicit differentiation for fixed-point projections, reducing activation memory and synchronization overhead; and (iii) a Stiefel-constrained mixer via Cayley transforms, ensuring orthogonality without post-hoc normalization. Empirical evaluations on ARC-AGI demonstrate that JPmHC achieves faster convergence, higher accuracy, and lower computational cost compared to bistochastic baselines. As a flexible and scalable extension of HC, JPmHC advances spectrum-aware, stable, and efficient deep learning, offering insights into topological architecture design and foundational model evolution.

AI.title_translation: JPmHC：通过正交超连接实现的雅可比谱保持流形约束
AI.tldr: JPmHC通过将线性混合器约束在特定流形上（如Stiefel），取代了有缺陷的恒等跳跃，从而稳定了深度学习中的Hyper-Connections，提升了训练效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的超连接（HC）虽然性能提升显著，但损害了残差连接的恒等映射特性，导致训练不稳定、可扩展性受限和内存开销增加。需要一个框架来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出JPmHC框架，用可训练的线性混合器替换恒等跳跃，并通过将混合器M约束在算子范数有界流形（如双随机、Stiefel、Grassmann）上来控制梯度条件，从而增强稳定性。具体包括：(i) 自由概率分析预测雅可比谱；(ii) 用于固定点投影的内存高效隐式微分；(iii) 通过Cayley变换实现的Stiefel约束混合器。
AI.result: 在ARC-AGI上的实证评估表明，JPmHC相比于双随机基线实现了更快的收敛速度、更高的准确性和更低的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: JPmHC作为HC的一个灵活且可扩展的扩展，通过频谱感知、稳定和高效的方式推进了深度学习的发展，为拓扑架构设计和基础模型演进提供了见解。
AI.translation: 最近深度学习的进步，以超连接（HC）为例，通过引入更宽的残差流和多样化的连接模式，扩展了残差连接的范式。虽然这些创新带来了显著的性能提升，但它们损害了残差连接的恒等映射特性，导致训练不稳定、可扩展性受限和内存开销增加。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了JPmHC（雅可比谱保持流形约束超连接），一个用可训练的线性混合器替换恒等跳跃，该混合器作用于n个并行流，并明确控制梯度条件化的框架。通过将混合器M约束在算子范数有界流形（例如，双随机、Stiefel、Grassmann）上，JPmHC可以防止梯度病态并增强稳定性。JPmHC引入了三个关键贡献：（i）一个预测结构化跳跃的雅可比谱的自由概率分析，为混合器选择提供可行的设计规则；（ii）用于固定点投影的内存高效隐式微分，减少了激活内存和同步开销；（iii）通过Cayley变换实现的Stiefel约束混合器，无需事后归一化即可确保正交性。在ARC-AGI上的实证评估表明，与双随机基线相比，JPmHC实现了更快的收敛速度、更高的准确性和更低的计算成本。作为HC的一个灵活且可扩展的扩展，JPmHC推进了频谱感知、稳定和高效的深度学习，为拓扑架构设计和基础模型演进提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了JPmHC（雅可比谱保持流形约束超连接），一个通过将可训练线性混合器约束在特定流形上，来解决现有超连接（HC）破坏恒等映射特性、导致训练不稳定的新框架。JPmHC通过自由概率分析、隐式微分和正交约束，有效控制了梯度条件，并在实验中展示了更优的收敛速度、准确性和效率。
AI.keywords: Hyper-Connections, 雅可比谱, 恒等映射, 梯度稳定性, 正交连接
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了通过将可训练线性混合器约束在算子范数有界流形上，来解决现有超连接（HC）牺牲恒等映射特性导致的不稳定性和开销问题。其核心贡献在于通过自由概率分析预测雅可比谱，并使用隐式微分和正交约束来提高稳定性和效率。这为设计更稳定、更高效的深度学习架构提供了新的拓扑学视角。

title: Multi-Level Conditioning by Pairing Localized Text and Sketch for Fashion Image Generation
summary: Sketches offer designers a concise yet expressive medium for early-stage fashion ideation by specifying structure, silhouette, and spatial relationships, while textual descriptions complement sketches to convey material, color, and stylistic details. Effectively combining textual and visual modalities requires adherence to the sketch visual structure when leveraging the guidance of localized attributes from text. We present LOcalized Text and Sketch with multi-level guidance (LOTS), a framework that enhances fashion image generation by combining global sketch guidance with multiple localized sketch-text pairs. LOTS employs a Multi-level Conditioning Stage to independently encode local features within a shared latent space while maintaining global structural coordination. Then, the Diffusion Pair Guidance stage integrates both local and global conditioning via attention-based guidance within the diffusion model's multi-step denoising process. To validate our method, we develop Sketchy, the first fashion dataset where multiple text-sketch pairs are provided per image. Sketchy provides high-quality, clean sketches with a professional look and consistent structure. To assess robustness beyond this setting, we also include an "in the wild" split with non-expert sketches, featuring higher variability and imperfections. Experiments demonstrate that our method strengthens global structural adherence while leveraging richer localized semantic guidance, achieving improvement over state-of-the-art. The dataset, platform, and code are publicly available.

AI.title_translation: 多层次条件生成：结合局部文本和草图进行时尚图像生成
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为LOTS的框架，通过结合全局草图引导和多个局部文本-草图对，来增强时尚图像生成。该框架使用多层次条件模块独立编码局部特征，并利用扩散对引导阶段整合局部和全局信息。研究还发布了一个新的时尚数据集Sketchy来验证该方法，实验结果表明LOTS在保持全局结构的同时，能更好地利用局部语义信息，优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 需要一种有效的方法来结合文本描述和草图的优势，以实现更精确和富有表现力的时尚图像生成，特别是要解决如何将文本的局部属性与草图的全局结构相结合的问题。
AI.method: 提出LOTS框架，包含多层次条件模块（独立编码局部特征）和扩散对引导阶段（整合局部和全局信息）。同时，开发了一个新的时尚数据集Sketchy，包含专业和非专业草图，用于评估方法。
AI.result: LOTS框架在保持全局结构的同时，能够更好地利用局部语义信息进行时尚图像生成，并在实验中取得了优于现有最先进方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: LOTS框架能够有效地结合局部文本和全局草图信息，实现高质量的时尚图像生成，并且所提出的Sketchy数据集为该领域的研究提供了重要资源。
AI.translation: 草图为设计师提供了简洁而富有表现力的早期时尚构思媒介，通过指定结构、轮廓和空间关系，而文本描述则通过传达材料、颜色和风格细节来补充草图。有效结合文本和视觉模态需要利用来自文本的局部属性的指导，同时遵守草图的视觉结构。我们提出了局部文本和草图与多层次引导（LOTS）的框架，通过结合全局草图引导和多个局部草图-文本对来增强时尚图像生成。LOTS采用多层次条件模块，在保持全局结构协调的同时，独立地在共享的潜在空间中编码局部特征。然后，扩散对引导阶段通过扩散模型的多步去噪过程中的基于注意力的引导，整合局部和全局条件。为了验证我们的方法，我们开发了Sketchy，这是第一个为每张图像提供多个文本-草图对的时尚数据集。Sketchy提供了高质量、干净且具有专业外观和一致结构的草图。为了评估该设置之外的鲁棒性，我们还包含了一个包含非专家草图的“野外”分割，其变异性和不完善性更高。实验表明，我们的方法在利用更丰富的局部语义引导的同时，加强了全局结构的一致性，并取得了优于最先进方法的改进。数据集、平台和代码都是公开的。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为LOTS的框架，用于时尚图像生成。该框架通过结合全局草图引导和多个局部文本-草图对，并利用多层次条件模块和扩散对引导阶段来整合局部和全局信息。研究还发布了一个新的时尚数据集Sketchy。实验结果表明，LOTS在保持全局结构的同时，能更好地利用局部语义信息，性能优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 时尚图像生成, 文本-草图结合, 多层次条件, 扩散模型, Sketchy数据集
AI.comments: 该研究提出的LOTS框架和Sketchy数据集在时尚图像生成领域具有重要意义。LOTS框架有效地结合了文本和草图的优势，解决了多模态信息融合的挑战。Sketchy数据集的发布为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源，特别是其包含的“野外”分割部分，有助于评估方法在真实世界复杂场景下的鲁棒性。然而，文章未详细说明LOTS框架在计算效率和可扩展性方面的表现，这可能是未来研究的一个方向。此外，对于不同风格和复杂度的时尚设计，该方法的效果仍需进一步的广泛验证。

title: Learning Smooth Time-Varying Linear Policies with an Action Jacobian Penalty
summary: Reinforcement learning provides a framework for learning control policies that can reproduce diverse motions for simulated characters. However, such policies often exploit unnatural high-frequency signals that are unachievable by humans or physical robots, making them poor representations of real-world behaviors. Existing work addresses this issue by adding a reward term that penalizes a large change in actions over time. This term often requires substantial tuning efforts. We propose to use the action Jacobian penalty, which penalizes changes in action with respect to the changes in simulated state directly through auto differentiation. This effectively eliminates unrealistic high-frequency control signals without task specific tuning. While effective, the action Jacobian penalty introduces significant computational overhead when used with traditional fully connected neural network architectures. To mitigate this, we introduce a new architecture called a Linear Policy Net (LPN) that significantly reduces the computational burden for calculating the action Jacobian penalty during training. In addition, a LPN requires no parameter tuning, exhibits faster learning convergence compared to baseline methods, and can be more efficiently queried during inference time compared to a fully connected neural network. We demonstrate that a Linear Policy Net, combined with the action Jacobian penalty, is able to learn policies that generate smooth signals while solving a number of motion imitation tasks with different characteristics, including dynamic motions such as a backflip and various challenging parkour skills. Finally, we apply this approach to create policies for dynamic motions on a physical quadrupedal robot equipped with an arm.

AI.title_translation: 学习带有动作雅可比惩罚的平滑时变线性策略
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动作雅可比惩罚方法，结合线性策略网络（LPN），以消除强化学习策略中不自然的、高频的控制信号，同时减少计算开销和参数调优，实现平滑的运动模仿和物理机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 强化学习策略常产生人类或物理机器人无法实现的不自然高频信号，现有方法通过惩罚动作随时间的大幅变化来解决，但这需要大量调优。
AI.method: 提出使用动作雅可比惩罚，通过自动微分直接惩罚动作随模拟状态变化，以消除不真实的高频控制信号。为减轻计算开销，引入线性策略网络（LPN）新架构，该架构无需参数调优，收敛更快，推理效率更高。
AI.result: 动作雅可比惩罚有效消除了不真实的高频控制信号，无需任务特定调优。线性策略网络（LPN）显著降低了计算负担，无需参数调优，学习收敛速度快于基线方法，推理时查询效率更高。结合LPN和动作雅可比惩罚，能够学习生成平滑信号的策略，解决了包括后空翻和跑酷等多种运动模仿任务，并成功应用于带机械臂的四足机器人进行动态运动。
AI.conclusion: 结合动作雅可比惩罚和线性策略网络（LPN）能够学习生成平滑信号的策略，有效解决了强化学习中高频控制信号的问题，并在多种运动模仿任务和物理机器人上展现出优越性能，同时减少了计算开销和调优需求。
AI.translation: 强化学习提供了一个学习控制策略的框架，可以为模拟角色重现各种动作。然而，这些策略常常利用不自然的高频信号，这对于人类或物理机器人来说是无法实现的，使得它们无法很好地代表真实世界的行为。现有工作通过添加一个惩罚动作随时间大幅变化的奖励项来解决这个问题。这个奖励项通常需要大量的调优工作。我们提出使用动作雅可比惩罚，它通过自动微分直接惩罚动作随模拟状态的变化。这有效地消除了不真实的高频控制信号，而无需任务特定的调优。尽管有效，但在与传统的全连接神经网络架构一起使用时，动作雅可比惩罚会引入显著的计算开销。为了缓解这个问题，我们引入了一种名为线性策略网络（LPN）的新架构，它显著降低了训练期间计算动作雅可比惩罚的计算负担。此外，LPN无需参数调优，与基线方法相比学习收敛速度更快，并且在推理时比全连接神经网络查询效率更高。我们证明，线性策略网络与动作雅可比惩罚相结合，能够学习生成平滑信号的策略，同时解决一系列具有不同特征的运动模仿任务，包括后空翻和各种具有挑战性的跑酷技能等动态运动。最后，我们将这种方法应用于为配备机械臂的物理四足机器人创建动态运动策略。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合动作雅可比惩罚和线性策略网络（LPN）的新方法，旨在解决强化学习中策略产生不自然高频信号的问题。动作雅可比惩罚通过直接惩罚动作随状态的变化来消除高频信号，而LPN则显著降低了计算开销、无需参数调优，并加速了学习收敛。实验证明，该方法能生成平滑的控制信号，成功完成多种运动模仿任务，并应用于物理四足机器人。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 动作雅可比惩罚, 线性策略网络, 平滑控制, 运动模仿
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新点在于提出了动作雅可比惩罚和线性策略网络（LPN）的结合。动作雅可比惩罚直接解决了强化学习中高频不自然动作的问题，而LPN则巧妙地解决了该惩罚引入的计算开销和调优难题，使得方法更高效、更实用。其在物理机器人上的应用潜力也十分重要。

title: Diff2DGS: Reliable Reconstruction of Occluded Surgical Scenes via 2D Gaussian Splatting
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Real-time reconstruction of deformable surgical scenes is vital for advancing robotic surgery, improving surgeon guidance, and enabling automation. Recent methods achieve dense reconstructions from da Vinci robotic surgery videos, with Gaussian Splatting (GS) offering real-time performance via graphics acceleration. However, reconstruction quality in occluded regions remains limited, and depth accuracy has not been fully assessed, as benchmarks like EndoNeRF and StereoMIS lack 3D ground truth. We propose Diff2DGS, a novel two-stage framework for reliable 3D reconstruction of occluded surgical scenes. In the first stage, a diffusion-based video module with temporal priors inpaints tissue occluded by instruments with high spatial-temporal consistency. In the second stage, we adapt 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) with a Learnable Deformation Model (LDM) to capture dynamic tissue deformation and anatomical geometry. We also extend evaluation beyond prior image-quality metrics by performing quantitative depth accuracy analysis on the SCARED dataset. Diff2DGS outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both appearance and geometry, reaching 38.02 dB PSNR on EndoNeRF and 34.40 dB on StereoMIS. Furthermore, our experiments demonstrate that optimizing for image quality alone does not necessarily translate into optimal 3D reconstruction accuracy. To address this, we further optimize the depth quality of the reconstructed 3D results, ensuring more faithful geometry in addition to high-fidelity appearance.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: QPTAS for MWIS and finding large sparse induced subgraphs in graphs with few independent long holes
summary:
We present a quasipolynomial-time approximation scheme (QPTAS) for the Maximum Independent Set (\textsc{MWIS}) in graphs with a bounded number of pairwise vertex-disjoint and non-adjacent long induced cycles. More formally, for every fixed $s$ and $t$, we show a QPTAS for \textsc{MWIS} in graphs that exclude $sC_t$ as an induced minor. Combining this with known results, we obtain a QPTAS for the problem of finding a largest induced subgraph of bounded treewidth with given hereditary property definable in Counting Monadic Second Order Logic, in the same classes of graphs.
  This is a step towards a conjecture of Gartland and Lokshtanov which asserts that for any planar graph $H$, graphs that exclude $H$ as an induced minor admit a polynomial-time algorithm for the latter problem. This conjecture is notoriously open and even its weaker variants are confirmed only for very restricted graphs $H$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在具有有限数量成对不相交且不相邻的长诱导环的图上，求解最大独立集（MWIS）问题的拟多项式时间近似方案（QPTAS）。
AI.motivation: 本文的研究是朝着Gartland和Lokshtanov的一个猜想迈进，该猜想提出对于任何平面图H，排除H作为诱导子图的图允许对特定问题使用多项式时间算法。这个猜想众所周知是开放的。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种拟多项式时间近似方案（QPTAS）。具体来说，对于每个固定的s和t，作者展示了在排除sCt作为诱导子图的图上求解MWIS问题的QPTAS。
AI.result: 本文在具有有界数量的成对顶点不相交且不相邻的长诱导环的图上，为最大独立集（MWIS）问题提供了一个QPTAS。结合已知结果，在相同的图类中，对于在Counting Monadic Second Order Logic中可定义的具有给定遗传性质的、有界树宽的最大诱导子图问题，也获得了QPTAS。
