title: New perturbation bounds for low rank approximation of matrices: Beyond Eckard-Young-Mirsky
summary: Let $A$ be an $m \times n$ matrix with rank $r$ and spectral decomposition $A = \sum _{i=1}^r σ_i u_i v_i^\top, $ where $σ_i$ are its singular values, ordered decreasingly, and $u_i, v_i$ are the corresponding left and right singular vectors. For a parameter $1 \le p \le r$, $A_p := \sum_{i=1}^p σ_i u_i v_i^\top$ is the best rank $p$ approximation of $A$. In practice, one often chooses $p$ to be small, leading to the commonly used phrase "low-rank approximation". Low-rank approximation plays a central role in data science because it can substantially reduce the dimensionality of the original data, the matrix $A$. For a large data matrix $A$, one typically computes a rank-$p$ approximation $A_p$ for a suitably chosen small $p$, stores $A_p$, and uses it as input for further computations. The reduced dimension of $A_p$ enables faster computations and significant data compression. In practice, noise is inevitable. We often have access only to noisy data $\tilde A = A + E$, where $E$ represents the noise. Consequently, the low-rank approximation used as input in many downstream tasks is $\tilde A_p$, the best rank $p$ approximation of $\tilde A$, rather than $A_p$. Therefore, it is natural and important to estimate the error $ \| \tilde A_p - A_p \|$. This error plays a critical role in estimating the accuracy of the output of any process involving a low-rank approximation of noisy input. In this paper, we develop a new method (based on contour analysis) to bound $\| \tilde A_p - A_p \|$, exploiting new parameters that measure the skewness between the noise matrix $E$ and the singular vectors of $A$. In many settings, we obtain notable quantitative improvements compared to classical approaches (using the Eckart-Young-Mirsky theorem or the Davis-Kahan theorem). This leads to a more accurate error estimate and better guarantee in the analysis of many algorithmic tasks.

title: Two Constraint Compilation Methods for Lifted Planning
summary: We study planning in a fragment of PDDL with qualitative state-trajectory constraints, capturing safety requirements, task ordering conditions, and intermediate sub-goals commonly found in real-world problems. A prominent approach to tackle such problems is to compile their constraints away, leading to a problem that is supported by state-of-the-art planners. Unfortunately, existing compilers do not scale on problems with a large number of objects and high-arity actions, as they necessitate grounding the problem before compilation. To address this issue, we propose two methods for compiling away constraints without grounding, making them suitable for large-scale planning problems. We prove the correctness of our compilers and outline their worst-case time complexity. Moreover, we present a reproducible empirical evaluation on the domains used in the latest International Planning Competition. Our results demonstrate that our methods are efficient and produce planning specifications that are orders of magnitude more succinct than the ones produced by compilers that ground the domain, while remaining competitive when used for planning with a state-of-the-art planner.

title: ExPairT-LLM: Exact Learning for LLM Code Selection by Pairwise Queries
summary: Despite recent advances in LLMs, the task of code generation is still challenging. To cope, code selection algorithms select the best program from multiple programs generated by an LLM. However, existing algorithms can fail to identify the correct program, either because they can misidentify nonequivalent programs or because they rely on an LLM and assume it always correctly determines the output for every input. We present ExPairT-LLM, an exact learning algorithm for code selection that selects a program by posing to an LLM oracle two new types of queries: pairwise membership and pairwise equivalence. These queries are simpler for LLMs and enable ExPairT-LLM to identify the correct program through a tournament, which is robust to some LLM mistakes. We evaluate ExPairT-LLM on four popular code datasets. Its pass@1 (success rate) outperforms the state-of-the-art code selection algorithm on average by +13.0% and up to +27.1%. It also improves the pass@1 of LLMs performing complex reasoning by +24.0%.

title: A Neuromorphic Architecture for Scalable Event-Based Control
summary: This paper introduces the ``rebound Winner-Take-All (RWTA)" motif as the basic element of a scalable neuromorphic control architecture. From the cellular level to the system level, the resulting architecture combines the reliability of discrete computation and the tunability of continuous regulation: it inherits the discrete computation capabilities of winner-take-all state machines and the continuous tuning capabilities of excitable biophysical circuits. The proposed event-based framework addresses continuous rhythmic generation and discrete decision-making in a unified physical modeling language. We illustrate the versatility, robustness, and modularity of the architecture through the nervous system design of a snake robot.

title: Greedy matroid base packings with applications to dynamic graph density and orientations
summary:
Greedy minimum weight spanning tree packings have proven to be useful in connectivity-related problems. We study the process of greedy minimum weight base packings in general matroids and explore its applications.
  For general matroids, we observe two characterizations of the limit of the base packings (``the vector of ideal loads''). Specialized to graphic matroids, it implies the characterizations from [Cen, Fleischmann, Li, Li, Panigrahi, FOCS'25], namely, their entropy-minimization theorem and their bottom-up cut hierarchy.
  We give combinatorial results on the greedy tree packings. We show that a tree packing of $O(λ^5\log m)$ trees contains a tree crossing some min-cut once, which improves the bound $O(λ^7\log^3m)$ from [Thorup, Combinatorica'07]. We also strengthen the lower bound on the edge load convergence rate from [de Vos, Christiansen, SODA'25], showing that Thorup's upper bound is tight up to a logarithmic factor.
  When specialized to bicircular matroids, our results yield an algorithm for the approximate fully-dynamic densest subgraph density $ρ$. We maintain a $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation of the density with a worst-case update time $O((ρ_{\max}\varepsilon^{-2}+\varepsilon^{-4})ρ_{\max}\log^3 m)$, where $ρ_{\max}$ is a fixed known upper bound on $ρ$. This complexity is worse than the state-of-the-art dynamic approximate density. However, our algorithm offers a new approach to the problem, which could be appealing due to its simplicity. We also can maintain an implicit fractional out-orientation with a guarantee that all out-degrees are at most $(1+\varepsilon)ρ$.
  Our algorithms above work by greedily packing pseudoforests, and require maintenance of a minimum-weight pseudoforest in a dynamically changing graph. We show that this problem can be solved in $O(\log n)$ worst-case time per edge insertion or deletion.

title: Combinatorial Optimization using Comparison Oracles
summary:
In linear combinatorial optimization, we aim to find $S^* = \arg\min_{S \in \mathcal{F}} \langle w,\mathbf{1}_S \rangle$ for a family $\mathcal{F} \subseteq 2^U$ over a ground set $U$ of $n$ elements. Traditionally, $w$ is known or accessible via a value oracle. Motivated by practical applications involving pairwise preferences, we study the weaker and more robust comparison oracle, which for any $S, T \in \mathcal{F}$ reveals only if $w(S) <, =, \text{ or } > w(T)$. We investigate the query complexity and computational efficiency of optimizing in this model.
  We present three main contributions. (1) Query Complexity: We establish that the query complexity over any arbitrary set system $\mathcal{F} \subseteq 2^U$ is $\tilde{O}(n^2)$. This demonstrates a fundamental separation between information and computational complexity, as the runtime may still be exponential for NP-hard problems. (2) Algorithmic Frameworks: We develop two general tools. First, a Dual Ellipsoid framework establishes an efficient reduction from optimization to certification. It shows that to optimize efficiently, it suffices to efficiently certify a candidate's optimality using only comparisons. Second, Global Subspace Learning (GSL) sorts all feasible sets using $O(nB \log(nB))$ queries for integer weights bounded by $B$. We efficiently implement GSL for linear matroids, yielding improved query complexities for problems like $k$-SUM, SUBSET-SUM, and $A+B$ sorting. (3) Combinatorial Applications: We give the first polynomial-time, low-query algorithms for classic problems, including minimum cuts, minimum weight spanning trees (and matroid bases), bipartite matching (and matroid intersection), and shortest $s$-$t$ paths.
  Our work provides the first general query complexity bounds and efficient algorithmic results for this fundamental model.

title: MUCH: A Multilingual Claim Hallucination Benchmark
comments: To appear in Proceedings of LREC 2026
summary: Claim-level Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is a promising approach to mitigate the lack of reliability in Large Language Models (LLMs). We introduce MUCH, the first claim-level UQ benchmark designed for fair and reproducible evaluation of future methods under realistic conditions. It includes 4,873 samples across four European languages (English, French, Spanish, and German) and four instruction-tuned open-weight LLMs. Unlike prior claim-level benchmarks, we release 24 generation logits per token, facilitating the development of future white-box methods without re-generating data. Moreover, in contrast to previous benchmarks that rely on manual or LLM-based segmentation, we propose a new deterministic algorithm capable of segmenting claims using as little as 0.2% of the LLM generation time. This makes our segmentation approach suitable for real-time monitoring of LLM outputs, ensuring that MUCH evaluates UQ methods under realistic deployment constraints. Finally, our evaluations show that current methods still have substantial room for improvement in both performance and efficiency.
comment: To appear in Proceedings of LREC 2026

title: Online Smoothed Demand Management
summary: We introduce and study a class of online problems called online smoothed demand management $(\texttt{OSDM})$, motivated by paradigm shifts in grid integration and energy storage for large energy consumers such as data centers. In $\texttt{OSDM}$, an operator makes two decisions at each time step: an amount of energy to be purchased, and an amount of energy to be delivered (i.e., used for computation). The difference between these decisions charges (or discharges) the operator's energy storage (e.g., a battery). Two types of demand arrive online: base demand, which must be covered at the current time, and flexible demand, which can be satisfied at any time before a demand-specific deadline $Δ_t$. The operator's goal is to minimize a cost (subject to above constraints) that combines a cost of purchasing energy, a cost for delivering energy (if applicable), and smoothness penalties on the purchasing and delivery rates to discourage fluctuations and encourage ``grid healthy'' decisions. $\texttt{OSDM}$ generalizes several problems in the online algorithms literature while being the first to fully model applications of interest. We propose a competitive algorithm for $\texttt{OSDM}$ called $\texttt{PAAD}$ (partitioned accounting & aggregated decisions) and show it achieves the optimal competitive ratio. To overcome the pessimism typical of worst-case analysis, we also propose a novel learning framework that provides guarantees on the worst-case competitive ratio (i.e., to provide robustness against nonstationarity) while allowing end-to-end differentiable learning of the best algorithm on historical instances of the problem. We evaluate our algorithms in a case study of a grid-integrated data center with battery storage, showing that $\texttt{PAAD}$ effectively solves the problem and end-to-end learning achieves substantial performance improvements compared to $\texttt{PAAD}$.

title: Towards Realistic Guarantees: A Probabilistic Certificate for SmoothLLM
summary: The SmoothLLM defense provides a certification guarantee against jailbreaking attacks, but it relies on a strict "k-unstable" assumption that rarely holds in practice. This strong assumption can limit the trustworthiness of the provided safety certificate. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a more realistic probabilistic framework, "(k, $\varepsilon$)-unstable," to certify defenses against diverse jailbreaking attacks, from gradient-based (GCG) to semantic (PAIR). We derive a new, data-informed lower bound on SmoothLLM's defense probability by incorporating empirical models of attack success, providing a more trustworthy and practical safety certificate. By introducing the notion of (k, $\varepsilon$)-unstable, our framework provides practitioners with actionable safety guarantees, enabling them to set certification thresholds that better reflect the real-world behavior of LLMs. Ultimately, this work contributes a practical and theoretically-grounded mechanism to make LLMs more resistant to the exploitation of their safety alignments, a critical challenge in secure AI deployment.

title: MIST: Mutual Information Estimation Via Supervised Training
summary: We propose a fully data-driven approach to designing mutual information (MI) estimators. Since any MI estimator is a function of the observed sample from two random variables, we parameterize this function with a neural network (MIST) and train it end-to-end to predict MI values. Training is performed on a large meta-dataset of 625,000 synthetic joint distributions with known ground-truth MI. To handle variable sample sizes and dimensions, we employ a two-dimensional attention scheme ensuring permutation invariance across input samples. To quantify uncertainty, we optimize a quantile regression loss, enabling the estimator to approximate the sampling distribution of MI rather than return a single point estimate. This research program departs from prior work by taking a fully empirical route, trading universal theoretical guarantees for flexibility and efficiency. Empirically, the learned estimators largely outperform classical baselines across sample sizes and dimensions, including on joint distributions unseen during training. The resulting quantile-based intervals are well-calibrated and more reliable than bootstrap-based confidence intervals, while inference is orders of magnitude faster than existing neural baselines. Beyond immediate empirical gains, this framework yields trainable, fully differentiable estimators that can be embedded into larger learning pipelines. Moreover, exploiting MI's invariance to invertible transformations, meta-datasets can be adapted to arbitrary data modalities via normalizing flows, enabling flexible training for diverse target meta-distributions.

title: CDLM: Consistency Diffusion Language Models For Faster Sampling
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer a promising parallel generation paradigm but suffer from slow inference due to numerous refinement steps and the inability to use standard KV caching. We introduce CDLM (Consistency Diffusion Language Models), a training-based acceleration method that simultaneously tackles both bottlenecks. CDLM integrates consistency modeling to drastically reduce the number of required sampling steps by enabling multi-token finalization. Furthermore, we enforce a block-wise causal attention mask during fine-tuning, making the model fully compatible with KV caching. Experiments show CDLM achieves 3.6x-14.5x lower latency while maintaining competitive accuracy on math and coding tasks. The full training and evaluation code is available at https://github.com/SqueezeAILab/CDLM.

title: Cross-Lingual Interleaving for Speech Language Models
summary: Spoken Language Models (SLMs) aim to learn linguistic competence directly from speech using discrete units, widening access to Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies for languages with limited written resources. However, progress has been largely English-centric due to scarce spoken evaluation benchmarks and training data, making cross-lingual learning difficult. We present a cross-lingual interleaving method that mixes speech tokens across languages without textual supervision. We also release an EN-FR training dataset, TinyStories (~42k hours), together with EN-FR spoken StoryCloze and TopicCloze benchmarks for cross-lingual semantic evaluation, both synthetically generated using GPT-4. On 360M and 1B SLMs under matched training-token budgets, interleaving improves monolingual semantic accuracy, enables robust cross-lingual continuation, and strengthens cross-lingual hidden-state alignment. Taken together, these results indicate that cross-lingual interleaving is a simple, scalable route to building multilingual SLMs that understand and converse across languages. All resources will be made open-source to support reproducibility.

AI.title_translation: 跨语言交错用于语音语言模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨语言交错方法，旨在解决语音语言模型（SLMs）中跨语言学习的挑战，并发布了新的多语言训练数据集和评估基准，实验证明该方法能有效提升SLMs的性能和跨语言能力。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型（SLMs）旨在直接从语音中学习语言能力，以扩大NLP技术对书面资源有限语言的覆盖。然而，由于缺乏口语评估基准和训练数据，研究进展主要集中在英语，使得跨语言学习变得困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种跨语言交错方法，该方法在没有文本监督的情况下混合了不同语言的语音tokens。同时，发布了一个EN-FR训练数据集TinyStories（约42k小时），以及两个用于跨语言语义评估的EN-FR口语StoryCloze和TopicCloze基准，这两个基准都是使用GPT-4合成生成的。
AI.result: 在匹配训练token预算的360M和1B SLMs上，交错方法提高了单语语义准确性，实现了鲁棒的跨语言连续性，并增强了跨语言隐藏状态对齐。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言交错是构建能够跨语言理解和对话的多语言SLMs的一种简单、可扩展的途径。
AI.translation: 语音语言模型（SLMs）旨在直接从语音中学习语言能力，使用离散单元，从而扩大了自然语言处理（NLP）技术对书面资源有限语言的访问。然而，由于口语评估基准和训练数据的稀缺，进展主要以英语为中心，使得跨语言学习变得困难。我们提出了一种跨语言交错方法，该方法在没有文本监督的情况下混合了不同语言的语音tokens。我们还发布了一个EN-FR训练数据集TinyStories（约42k小时），以及两个用于跨语言语义评估的EN-FR口语StoryCloze和TopicCloze基准，这两个基准都是使用GPT-4合成生成的。在匹配训练token预算的360M和1B SLMs上，交错方法提高了单语语义准确性，实现了鲁棒的跨语言连续性，并增强了跨语言隐藏状态对齐。综合来看，这些结果表明跨语言交错是构建能够跨语言理解和对话的多语言SLMs的一种简单、可扩展的途径。所有资源都将开源以支持可重现性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种针对语音语言模型（SLMs）的跨语言交错方法，旨在克服多语言语音处理中以英语为中心和数据稀缺的问题。该方法在没有文本监督的情况下混合了不同语言的语音tokens。作者还发布了一个大型的EN-FR训练数据集（TinyStories，约42k小时）和两个使用GPT-4合成生成的跨语言口语评估基准（StoryCloze和TopicCloze）。实验表明，这种交错方法提高了单语语义准确性，促进了鲁棒的跨语言连续性，并改善了SLMs中的隐藏状态对齐，展示了构建真正多语言SLMs的简单且可扩展的途径。
AI.keywords: 跨语言交错, 语音语言模型, 多语言SLMs, 口语基准, 语义评估
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了无需文本监督的跨语言交错方法，有效解决了多语言语音语言模型训练中的数据稀缺问题。同时，通过利用GPT-4生成新的跨语言口语评估基准，为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。该研究为构建能够理解和跨语言对话的多语言SLMs提供了一个简单且可扩展的解决方案，具有重要的实用价值和研究意义。

title: Learning to Orchestrate Agents in Natural Language with the Conductor
summary: Powerful large language models (LLMs) from different providers have been expensively trained and finetuned to specialize across varying domains. In this work, we introduce a new kind of Conductor model trained with reinforcement learning to automatically discover powerful coordination strategies among LLMs. Our Conductor learns not only to design targeted communication topologies for effective agent-to-agent collaboration, but also to prompt engineer focused instructions to the LLMs to maximally leverage their individual capabilities. We show that, by learning optimal coordination strategies over pools of powerful worker LLMs, a 7B Conductor achieves significant performance gains beyond any individual worker, attaining state-of-the-art results in challenging reasoning benchmarks, such as LiveCodeBench and GPQA. By training with randomized agent pools, our conductor effectively adapts to arbitrary sets of open- and closed-source agents, meeting any user requirements. Furthermore, allowing the Conductor to select itself as a worker gives rise to recursive topologies, elevating performance with a new form of dynamic test-time scaling through online iterative adaptation. More broadly, ours is among the early work demonstrating language model coordination can be unlocked through RL, where powerful coordination strategies emerge naturally in LLMs through pure end-to-end reward maximization.

AI.title_translation: 使用Conductor在自然语言中编排智能体
AI.tldr: Conductor模型通过强化学习学习如何协调不同的LLM，设计通信拓扑并进行提示工程，从而在推理基准测试中取得显著性能提升，甚至能进行递归适应。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型（LLMs）在不同领域经过昂贵的训练和微调，但如何有效地协调它们以最大化集体能力是一个挑战。本文旨在通过自动化发现LLMs之间的强大协调策略来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 引入了一种新的Conductor模型，该模型通过强化学习（RL）进行训练。Conductor学习设计有针对性的通信拓扑，以实现有效的智能体间协作，并对LLMs进行提示工程，以最大限度地利用其个体能力。通过随机化智能体池进行训练，使其能够适应任意的开源和闭源智能体。此外，允许Conductor选择自身作为工作智能体，从而产生递归拓扑，通过在线迭代适应实现动态测试时扩展。
AI.result: 一个7B的Conductor模型通过学习强大的工作LLM池上的最佳协调策略，实现了超越任何单个工作智能体的显著性能提升。在LiveCodeBench和GPQA等具有挑战性的推理基准测试中，取得了最先进的结果。通过递归拓扑，通过动态测试时扩展提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究是早期证明语言模型协调可以通过强化学习解锁的工作之一，其中强大的协调策略通过纯粹的端到端奖励最大化在LLM中自然涌现。Conductor模型能够有效地协调和利用不同LLM的能力，在复杂推理任务中表现出色。
AI.translation: 来自不同提供商的强大大型语言模型（LLMs）经过昂贵的训练和微调，以在不同领域实现专业化。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种新型的Conductor模型，该模型通过强化学习进行训练，以自动发现LLMs之间强大的协调策略。我们的Conductor不仅学习设计有针对性的通信拓扑以实现有效的智能体间协作，而且还对LLMs进行提示工程，以最大限度地利用它们的个体能力。我们展示了，通过学习强大的工作LLM池上的最佳协调策略，一个7B的Conductor模型实现了超越任何单个工作智能体的显著性能提升，在LiveCodeBench和GPQA等具有挑战性的推理基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。通过使用随机化的智能体池进行训练，我们的Conductor能够有效地适应任意的开源和闭源智能体集合，满足任何用户需求。此外，允许Conductor选择自身作为工作智能体，从而产生了递归拓扑，通过在线迭代适应这种新形式的动态测试时扩展提升了性能。更广泛地说，我们的工作是早期证明语言模型协调可以通过强化学习解锁的工作之一，其中强大的协调策略通过纯粹的端到端奖励最大化在LLMs中自然涌现。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个名为Conductor的新型模型，它利用强化学习来自动发现并执行大型语言模型（LLMs）之间的有效协调策略。Conductor能够设计定制的通信拓扑和进行精细的提示工程，以最大化不同LLMs的个体能力，从而在推理基准测试中取得超越单一LLM的显著性能提升。该模型通过适应随机化的智能体池来兼容各种开源和闭源LLM，并且通过允许Conductor自我选择作为工作智能体，实现了递归适应和动态性能扩展。这项工作强调了强化学习在解锁LLM协调潜力方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: Conductor模型, 强化学习, LLM协调, 提示工程, 多智能体系统
AI.comments: 这项工作具有重要的创新性，因为它提出了一种通过强化学习自动协调和优化多个异构LLM的新范式。Conductor模型通过学习通信拓扑和提示工程，有效地整合了不同LLM的优势，解决了单一LLM能力有限的问题。递归拓扑的设计是另一个亮点，它通过自我适应实现了动态性能提升，为未来的多智能体系统提供了新的思路。其重要性在于，它为构建更强大、更灵活的AI系统提供了一种通用的方法，能够适应不断变化的LLM生态系统。

title: Amortized Inference of Multi-Modal Posteriors using Likelihood-Weighted Normalizing Flows
summary: We present a novel technique for amortized posterior estimation using Normalizing Flows trained with likelihood-weighted importance sampling. This approach allows for the efficient inference of theoretical parameters in high-dimensional inverse problems without the need for posterior training samples. We implement the method on multi-modal benchmark tasks in 2D and 3D to check for the efficacy. A critical observation of our study is the impact of the topology of the base distributions on the modelled posteriors. We find that standard unimodal base distributions fail to capture disconnected support, resulting in spurious probability bridges between modes. We demonstrate that initializing the flow with a Gaussian Mixture Model that matches the cardinality of the target modes significantly improves reconstruction fidelity, as measured by some distance and divergence metrics.

AI.title_translation: 使用似然加权归一化流的摊销式多模态后验推断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用似然加权归一化流进行摊销式后验估计的新技术，解决了高维逆问题中多模态后验的推断挑战。研究发现，通过使用与目标模态数量匹配的高斯混合模型初始化流，能显著提高重建保真度，避免了标准单峰基分布产生的虚假概率桥。
AI.motivation: 解决高维逆问题中理论参数的有效推断问题，尤其是在无需后验训练样本的情况下。同时，旨在克服标准单峰基分布在处理多模态后验时无法捕获不连通支持域并产生虚假概率桥的局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种使用似然加权重要性采样训练的归一化流进行摊销式后验估计的新技术。该方法在2D和3D多模态基准任务上进行了实现和验证。研究了基分布拓扑对建模后验的影响，并通过使用与目标模态基数匹配的高斯混合模型初始化流来改进模型性能。
AI.result: 1. 该方法能够实现高维逆问题中理论参数的有效推断，且无需后验训练样本。2. 基分布的拓扑结构对建模后验有关键影响。3. 标准的单峰基分布无法捕获不连通的支持域，导致模态之间出现虚假的概率桥。4. 使用与目标模态基数匹配的高斯混合模型初始化流，能够显著提高重建保真度，并通过距离和散度指标进行衡量。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用与目标模态基数匹配的高斯混合模型初始化归一化流，可以显著提高多模态后验推断的重建保真度，有效解决了标准单峰基分布在处理复杂多模态后验时出现的局限性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种使用似然加权重要性采样训练的归一化流进行摊销式后验估计的新技术。这种方法可以在高维逆问题中高效推断理论参数，而无需后验训练样本。我们在2D和3D多模态基准任务上实现了该方法以检查其有效性。我们研究的一个关键观察结果是基分布的拓扑结构对建模后验的影响。我们发现标准的单峰基分布无法捕获不连通的支持域，导致模态之间出现虚假的概率桥。我们证明，使用与目标模态基数匹配的高斯混合模型初始化流，可以显著提高重建保真度，通过一些距离和散度指标进行衡量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于似然加权重要性采样训练的归一化流新方法，用于摊销式多模态后验推断，实现在高维逆问题中无需后验训练样本即可高效推断理论参数。研究强调了基分布拓扑对建模后验的关键影响，并指出标准单峰基分布在处理多模态后验时会产生虚假连接。通过采用与目标模态数量匹配的高斯混合模型初始化流，该方法显著提升了重建保真度。
AI.keywords: 摊销式推断, 多模态后验, 归一化流, 似然加权采样, 高斯混合模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的方法，将似然加权重要性采样与归一化流结合，解决了高维逆问题中多模态后验推断的挑战。其关键创新在于识别并解决了标准归一化流在处理多模态后验时基分布拓扑结构不匹配的问题，通过引入高斯混合模型初始化显著提升了性能，为复杂后验分布的建模提供了新的思路和实用改进。

title: Group Representational Position Encoding
summary: We present GRAPE (Group Representational Position Encoding), a unified framework for positional encoding based on group actions. GRAPE unifies two families of mechanisms: (i) multiplicative rotations (Multiplicative GRAPE) in $\operatorname{SO}(d)$ and (ii) additive logit biases (Additive GRAPE) arising from unipotent actions in the general linear group $\mathrm{GL}$. In Multiplicative GRAPE, a position $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ (or $t \in \mathbb{R}$) acts as $\mathbf{G}(n) = \exp(n \, ω\, \mathbf{L})$ with a rank-2 skew-symmetric generator $\mathbf{L} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$, yielding a relative, compositional, norm-preserving map with a closed-form matrix exponential. RoPE is recovered exactly when the $d/2$ planes correspond to canonical coordinate pairs with a log-uniform spectrum. Learned commuting subspaces and compact non-commuting mixtures strictly extend this geometry to capture cross-subspace feature coupling at $O(d)$ and $O(r d)$ cost per head, respectively. In Additive GRAPE, additive logits arise from rank-1 (or low-rank) unipotent actions, recovering ALiBi and the Forgetting Transformer (FoX) as exact special cases while preserving an exact relative law and streaming cacheability. Overall, GRAPE provides a principled design space for positional geometry in long-context models, subsuming RoPE and ALiBi as special cases. Project page: https://github.com/model-architectures/GRAPE.

AI.tldr: GRAPE（群表示位置编码）是一个统一的位置编码框架，它基于群作用，整合了乘法旋转（如RoPE）和加法logit偏差（如ALiBi和FoX）。
AI.motivation: 该论文旨在为长上下文模型中的位置几何提供一个有原则的设计空间，通过统一现有的位置编码机制来扩展其能力。
AI.method: GRAPE框架通过两种机制实现统一：(i) 乘法GRAPE，在SO(d)中使用乘法旋转，通过一个秩为2的斜对称生成器L，可以恢复RoPE，并扩展到学习的交换子空间和紧凑的非交换混合；(ii) 加法GRAPE，通过GL中幂等作用产生的加法logit偏差，可以恢复ALiBi和Forgetting Transformer (FoX)。
AI.result: GRAPE框架精确地恢复了RoPE、ALiBi和Forgetting Transformer (FoX)作为特例。乘法GRAPE扩展了几何结构以捕获跨子空间特征耦合，而加法GRAPE保留了精确的相对定律和流式可缓存性。总体而言，GRAPE为长上下文模型中的位置几何提供了一个有原则的设计空间。
AI.conclusion: GRAPE提供了一个统一且有原则的基于群作用的位置编码设计空间，它概括并扩展了RoPE和ALiBi等现有机制，为长上下文模型提供了更丰富的几何结构和能力。
AI.translation: 我们提出了GRAPE（群表示位置编码），一个基于群作用的位置编码统一框架。GRAPE统一了两大家族机制：(i) SO(d)中的乘法旋转（乘法GRAPE）和(ii) 由一般线性群GL中幂等作用产生的加法logit偏差（加法GRAPE）。在乘法GRAPE中，位置n∈Z（或t∈R）作用为G(n) = exp(nωL)，其中L∈Rd×d是一个秩为2的斜对称生成器，产生一个具有闭合形式矩阵指数的相对、组合、范数保持映射。当d/2个平面对应于具有对数均匀谱的规范坐标对时，RoPE被精确恢复。学习到的交换子空间和紧凑的非交换混合严格地将这种几何扩展到以O(d)和O(rd)的成本（每个头）捕获跨子空间特征耦合。在加法GRAPE中，加法logits源于秩为1（或低秩）的幂等作用，精确恢复了ALiBi和Forgetting Transformer (FoX)作为特例，同时保留了精确的相对定律和流式可缓存性。总的来说，GRAPE为长上下文模型中的位置几何提供了一个有原则的设计空间，将RoPE和ALiBi概括为特例。项目页面：https://github.com/model-architectures/GRAPE。
AI.summary: GRAPE（群表示位置编码）是一个统一的框架，利用群作用来设计位置编码。它整合了两种主要机制：基于SO(d)的乘法旋转（包括RoPE）和基于GL中幂等作用的加法logit偏差（包括ALiBi和FoX）。GRAPE通过提供一个有原则的设计空间，概括并扩展了现有方法，为长上下文模型提供了更丰富的几何表达能力。
AI.keywords: 位置编码, 群作用, RoPE, ALiBi, 长上下文模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的、基于群作用的位置编码框架GRAPE，它能够将RoPE和ALiBi等主流方法作为特例进行概括和扩展。通过引入乘法和加法两种GRAPE机制，论文不仅提供了一个理论上更为严谨和广阔的设计空间，还展示了如何通过学习的子空间和非交换混合来增强模型的特征耦合能力。这对于开发更高效、更强大的长上下文模型具有重要意义。

title: Correction of Decoupled Weight Decay
summary: Decoupled weight decay, solely responsible for the performance advantage of AdamW over Adam, has long been set to proportional to learning rate $γ$ without questioning. Some researchers have recently challenged such assumption and argued that decoupled weight decay should be set $\propto γ^2$ instead based on orthogonality arguments at steady state. To the contrary, we find that eliminating the contribution of the perpendicular component of the update to the weight norm leads to little change to the training dynamics. Instead, we derive that decoupled weight decay $\propto γ^2$ results in stable weight norm based on the simple assumption that updates become independent of the weights at steady state, regardless of the nature of the optimizer. Based on the same assumption, we derive and empirically verify that the Total Update Contribution (TUC) of a minibatch under the Scion optimizer is better characterized by the momentum-dependent effective learning rate whose optimal value transfers and we show that decoupled weight decay $\propto γ^2$ leads to stable weight and gradient norms and allows us to better control the training dynamics and improve the model performance.

AI.tldr: 解耦权重衰减应与学习率的平方（γ²）成比例，而非学习率（γ），以实现稳定的训练动态和提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 长期以来，解耦权重衰减一直被设定为与学习率γ成比例，但这一假设最近受到挑战。一些研究认为它应与γ²成比例。本文旨在修正这一理解并提供理论依据和经验验证。
AI.method: 本文推导出，基于更新在稳态时变得独立于权重的简单假设，解耦权重衰减与学习率的平方（γ²）成比例会导致稳定的权重范数。同时，还推导并经验验证了Scion优化器下minibatch的总更新贡献（TUC）与动量依赖的有效学习率的关系。
AI.result: 研究发现，解耦权重衰减与学习率的平方（γ²）成比例会导致稳定的权重范数、稳定的权重和梯度范数，从而更好地控制训练动态并提高模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 解耦权重衰减应设定为与学习率的平方（γ²）成比例，而非学习率（γ），这对于实现稳定的权重和梯度范数、有效控制训练动态以及提升模型性能至关重要。
AI.translation: 解耦权重衰减，作为AdamW优于Adam的唯一性能优势来源，长期以来一直被设定为与学习率γ成比例，而没有受到质疑。最近一些研究人员挑战了这一假设，并根据稳态正交性论证，认为解耦权重衰减应设定为∝γ²。与此相反，我们发现消除更新的垂直分量对权重范数的贡献对训练动态影响甚微。相反，我们推导出，基于更新在稳态时变得独立于权重的简单假设，无论优化器的性质如何，解耦权重衰减∝γ²会导致稳定的权重范数。基于相同的假设，我们推导出并经验验证，在Scion优化器下，一个minibatch的总更新贡献（TUC）更好地由依赖于动量的有效学习率来表征，其最优值可以迁移，并且我们表明解耦权重衰减∝γ²导致稳定的权重和梯度范数，并允许我们更好地控制训练动态并提高模型性能。
AI.summary: 本文挑战了将解耦权重衰减设定为与学习率（γ）成比例的常见做法。研究基于更新在稳态时独立于权重的假设，推导并经验验证了将解耦权重衰减设定为与学习率的平方（γ²）成比例，能够带来更稳定的权重和梯度范数，更好地控制训练动态，并最终提升模型性能。
AI.keywords: 解耦权重衰减, 学习率, AdamW, 优化, 稳定训练
AI.comments: 该论文修正了一个长期以来在优化器（如AdamW）中被“不加质疑”的假设。通过提供理论推导和经验验证，它为解耦权重衰减的正确设置（与学习率的平方成比例）提供了坚实基础，这对于提高训练稳定性和模型性能具有重要意义，可能对深度学习优化实践产生积极影响。

title: Guided Transfer Learning for Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Discrete diffusion models (DMs) have achieved strong performance in language and other discrete domains, offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive modeling. Yet this performance typically depends on large training datasets, challenging the performance of DMs in small-data regimes -- common under real-world constraints. Aimed at this challenge, recent work in continuous DMs suggests that transfer learning via classifier ratio-based guidance can adapt a pretrained DM to a related target distribution, often outperforming alternatives such as full-weight fine-tuning on the target data. By contrast, transfer learning for discrete DMs remains unexplored. We address this gap by exploring practical analogues of ratio-based transfer learning for discrete DMs. Our theoretical analysis shows that a direct extension of existing ratio-based guidance is computationally prohibitive, scaling with vocabulary size. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a scheduling mechanism that yields a practical algorithm, Guided Transfer Learning for discrete diffusion models (GTL). GTL enables sampling from a target distribution without modifying the pretrained denoiser and reduces the cost to linear scaling in vocabulary size, which in turn supports longer sequence generation. We evaluate GTL on sequential data, including synthetic Markov chains and language modeling tasks, and provide a detailed empirical analysis of its behavior. The results highlight a clear trade-off: when target datasets are large, weight fine-tuning is often preferable, whereas GTL becomes increasingly effective as target data shrinks. Finally, we experimentally demonstrate a key failure mode of GTL: when the source and target distributions overlap poorly, the ratio-based classifier required for guidance becomes unreliable, limiting transfer performance.

AI.title_translation: 离散扩散模型的引导式迁移学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为GTL的新方法，用于在小数据量下对离散扩散模型进行迁移学习，解决了现有方法计算成本高的问题，并展示了其在数据量较小时的有效性。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型在小数据量环境下表现不佳，而连续扩散模型的基于分类器比率的引导式迁移学习方法在离散领域尚未被探索，且直接扩展计算成本过高。
AI.method: 提出了引导式迁移学习（GTL）算法，通过引入调度机制，解决了现有比率引导方法在离散领域计算成本随词汇量增长的问题。GTL无需修改预训练去噪器，将成本降低到词汇量的线性缩放，并支持更长的序列生成。
AI.result: GTL在目标数据集较小时比权重微调更有效；但当源和目标分布重叠度低时，GTL的分类器比率引导会变得不可靠，限制了迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: GTL为离散扩散模型在小数据量下的迁移学习提供了一种实用且有效的解决方案，但其性能受源目标分布重叠度的影响。
AI.translation: 离散扩散模型（DMs）在语言和其他离散领域取得了强大的性能，为自回归建模提供了一个引人注目的替代方案。然而，这种性能通常依赖于大型训练数据集，这挑战了DMs在小数据量环境下的性能——这在现实世界约束下很常见。针对这一挑战，连续DMs的最新研究表明，通过基于分类器比率引导的迁移学习可以将预训练的DM适应到相关的目标分布，通常优于目标数据上的全权重微调等替代方案。相比之下，离散DMs的迁移学习仍未被探索。我们通过探索离散DMs中基于比率迁移学习的实际模拟来弥补这一空白。我们的理论分析表明，现有基于比率引导的直接扩展在计算上是 prohibitive 的，其成本随词汇量大小而扩展。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了一种调度机制，从而产生了一种实用算法，即离散扩散模型的引导式迁移学习（GTL）。GTL使得无需修改预训练去噪器即可从目标分布中采样，并将成本降低到词汇量的线性缩放，这反过来支持更长的序列生成。我们在包括合成马尔可夫链和语言建模任务在内的序列数据上评估了GTL，并提供了对其行为的详细实证分析。结果突出显示了一个明显的权衡：当目标数据集较大时，权重微调通常更可取，而随着目标数据量的减少，GTL变得越来越有效。最后，我们通过实验证明了GTL的一个关键失效模式：当源和目标分布重叠不佳时，用于引导的基于比率的分类器变得不可靠，从而限制了迁移性能。
AI.summary: 这篇论文提出了一种名为引导式迁移学习（GTL）的新方法，用于解决离散扩散模型在小数据量情境下性能不佳的问题。针对现有连续扩散模型迁移学习方法直接应用于离散领域时计算成本过高的问题，GTL通过引入调度机制，实现了无需修改预训练模型即可进行高效迁移学习，并将计算成本降至词汇量的线性级别。实验结果表明，GTL在目标数据集较小时优于传统的权重微调，但也指出当源目标分布重叠度低时，其性能会受到限制。
AI.keywords: 离散扩散模型, 迁移学习, 分类器引导, 小数据量, 语言建模
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过将连续扩散模型中的引导式迁移学习思想推广到离散领域，填补了一个重要的研究空白。GTL的创新之处在于其调度机制，有效解决了计算效率问题，使其在实际应用中更具可行性，尤其是在资源受限或数据稀缺的场景。其对权衡和失效模式的详细分析也增加了研究的深度和实用价值。

title: How Does Fourier Analysis Network Work? A Mechanism Analysis and a New Dual-Activation Layer Proposal
summary: Fourier Analysis Network (FAN) was recently proposed as a simple way to improve neural network performance by replacing part of Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) activations with sine and cosine functions. Although several studies have reported small but consistent gains across tasks, the underlying mechanism behind these improvements has remained unclear. In this work, we show that only the sine activation contributes positively to performance, whereas the cosine activation tends to be detrimental. Our analysis reveals that the improvement is not a consequence of the sine function's periodic nature; instead, it stems from the function's local behavior near x = 0, where its non-zero derivative mitigates the vanishing-gradient problem. We further show that FAN primarily alleviates the dying-ReLU problem, in which a neuron consistently receives negative inputs, produces zero gradients, and stops learning. Although modern ReLU-like activations, such as Leaky ReLU, GELU, and Swish, reduce ReLU's zero-gradient region, they still contain input domains where gradients remain significantly diminished, contributing to slower optimization and hindering rapid convergence. FAN addresses this limitation by introducing a more stable gradient pathway. This analysis shifts the understanding of FAN's benefits from a spectral interpretation to a concrete analysis of training dynamics, leading to the development of the Dual-Activation Layer (DAL), a more efficient convergence accelerator. We evaluate DAL on three tasks: classification of noisy sinusoidal signals versus pure noise, MNIST digit classification, and Electrocardiogram (ECG)-based biometric recognition. In all cases, DAL models converge faster and achieve equal or higher validation accuracy compared to models with conventional activations.

AI.title_translation: 傅里叶分析网络如何工作？一种机制分析和一种新的双激活层提议
AI.tldr: 本文分析了傅里叶分析网络（FAN）的工作机制，发现其性能提升归因于正弦激活函数在x=0附近的非零导数缓解了梯度消失问题，而非其周期性。在此基础上，提出了一种新的双激活层（DAL），能更有效地加速收敛并提高准确性。
AI.motivation: 傅里叶分析网络（FAN）虽能提升神经网络性能，但其内在机制尚不清楚。此外，ReLU及其变体存在梯度消失/死亡问题，导致优化缓慢和收敛困难。
AI.method: 通过分析正弦和余弦激活函数对FAN性能的贡献，揭示了正弦函数在x=0附近的局部行为（非零导数）而非其周期性，是缓解梯度消失和死亡ReLU问题的关键。在此机制分析的基础上，提出了一种新的双激活层（DAL）。并在三种任务上（噪声正弦信号分类、MNIST手写数字分类、ECG生物识别）评估了DAL。
AI.result: 分析表明只有正弦激活函数对性能有积极贡献，而余弦激活函数可能有害。性能提升并非源于正弦函数的周期性，而是其在x=0附近的非零导数缓解了梯度消失问题，特别是死亡ReLU问题。傅里叶分析网络通过引入更稳定的梯度路径来解决这一限制。提出的双激活层（DAL）在所有测试任务中都比使用传统激活函数的模型收敛更快，并达到相同或更高的验证准确率。
AI.conclusion: 本文将对傅里叶分析网络益处的理解从谱解释转向了对训练动态的具体分析，并在此基础上开发了双激活层（DAL），这是一种更高效的收敛加速器。
AI.translation: 傅里叶分析网络（FAN）最近被提出作为一种通过用正弦和余弦函数替换部分整流线性单元（ReLU）激活来提高神经网络性能的简单方法。尽管一些研究报告了在各种任务中取得了虽小但一致的性能提升，但这些改进背后的潜在机制仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们发现只有正弦激活函数对性能有积极贡献，而余弦激活函数往往是有害的。我们的分析揭示，性能提升并非是正弦函数周期性的结果；相反，它源于函数在x = 0附近的局部行为，其非零导数减轻了梯度消失问题。我们进一步表明，傅里叶分析网络主要缓解了死亡ReLU问题，即神经元持续接收负输入，产生零梯度，并停止学习。尽管现代ReLU类激活函数，如Leaky ReLU、GELU和Swish，减少了ReLU的零梯度区域，但它们仍然包含梯度显著减小的输入域，导致优化速度变慢并阻碍快速收敛。傅里叶分析网络通过引入更稳定的梯度路径来解决这一限制。这项分析将对傅里叶分析网络益处的理解从谱解释转向了对训练动态的具体分析，从而促成了双激活层（DAL）的开发，这是一种更高效的收敛加速器。我们在三项任务上评估了DAL：噪声正弦信号与纯噪声的分类、MNIST数字分类和基于心电图（ECG）的生物识别。在所有情况下，DAL模型比使用传统激活函数的模型收敛更快，并达到相同或更高的验证准确率。
AI.summary: 本文深入分析了傅里叶分析网络（FAN）的性能提升机制，发现其关键在于正弦激活函数在零点附近的非零导数缓解了梯度消失和死亡ReLU问题，而非其周期性。基于此洞察，作者提出了一种新的双激活层（DAL），该层通过提供更稳定的梯度路径，显著加速了模型收敛，并在多项分类任务中取得了与传统激活函数相当或更高的准确率。这项工作将对FAN的理解从宏观的谱分析转向了微观的训练动态分析。
AI.keywords: 傅里叶分析网络, 激活函数, 梯度消失, 死亡ReLU, 双激活层
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过深入的机制分析，澄清了傅里叶分析网络（FAN）的真正优势来源，纠正了之前可能存在的误解。其创新点在于将性能提升归因于激活函数局部行为对梯度问题的缓解，而非简单的周期性特性。在此基础上提出的双激活层（DAL）提供了一个更高效、更稳定的训练加速器，对于解决深度学习中常见的梯度消失/死亡问题具有重要意义。该研究不仅提供了理论见解，还通过实验验证了新方法的有效性，对神经网络激活函数的设计和优化提供了新的思路。

title: AI Epidemiology: achieving explainable AI through expert oversight patterns
summary:
AI Epidemiology is a framework for governing and explaining advanced AI systems by applying population-level surveillance methods to AI outputs. The approach mirrors the way in which epidemiologists enable public health interventions through statistical evidence before molecular mechanisms are understood. This bypasses the problem of model complexity which plagues current interpretability methods (such as SHAP and mechanistic interpretability) at the scale of deployed models.
  AI Epidemiology achieves this population-level surveillance by standardising capture of AI-expert interactions into structured assessment fields: risk level, alignment score, and accuracy score. These function as exposure variables which predict output failure through statistical associations, much like cholesterol and blood pressure act as exposure variables predicting cardiac events. Output-failure associations are subsequently validated against expert overrides and real-world outcomes.
  The framework places zero burden on experts and provides automatic audit trails by passively tracking expert convergence and divergence with AI recommendations. Since it analyses outputs rather than internal model computations, it also provides governance continuity when institutions update models and switch vendors. Finally, by providing reliability scores and semantic assessments (e.g. 'this recommendation resembles 500 cases overridden by experts due to guideline violations'), it enables experts and institutions to detect unreliable AI outputs before they cause harm. This democratises AI oversight by enabling domain experts to govern AI systems without requiring machine learning expertise.

AI.title_translation: AI流行病学：通过专家监督模式实现可解释AI
AI.tldr: AI流行病学通过对AI输出进行群体层面监控，实现可解释AI和治理，无需理解模型复杂性，并赋能领域专家。
AI.motivation: 当前可解释性方法（如SHAP和机械可解释性）在部署模型的规模上受到模型复杂性的困扰。需要一种绕过模型复杂性问题的方法来解释和治理高级AI系统。
AI.method: AI流行病学通过标准化捕获AI-专家交互，将其分为结构化评估字段（风险水平、对齐分数、准确性分数）。这些作为暴露变量，通过统计关联预测输出失败。这些关联通过专家干预和真实世界结果进行验证。该框架被动跟踪专家与AI建议的趋同和分歧，提供自动审计追踪，并分析输出而非内部模型计算。
AI.result: 该框架对专家零负担，提供自动审计追踪。它在模型更新和供应商切换时提供治理连续性。它提供可靠性分数和语义评估，使专家和机构能够在造成损害前检测不可靠的AI输出。它使领域专家无需机器学习专业知识即可治理AI系统。
AI.conclusion: AI流行病学提供了一种新颖且实用的方法，通过群体层面监控和专家监督模式实现AI的可解释性和治理，有效绕过模型复杂性问题，并赋能非机器学习专家。
AI.translation:
AI流行病学是一个通过将群体层面监测方法应用于AI输出来治理和解释高级AI系统的框架。这种方法类似于流行病学家在分子机制尚未被理解之前，通过统计证据促成公共卫生干预的方式。这绕过了当前可解释性方法（如SHAP和机械可解释性）在部署模型规模上所面临的模型复杂性问题。
AI流行病学通过将AI-专家交互的捕获标准化为结构化评估字段：风险水平、对齐分数和准确性分数来实现这种群体层面监测。这些作为暴露变量，通过统计关联预测输出失败，就像胆固醇和血压作为预测心脏事件的暴露变量一样。输出失败关联随后会根据专家干预和真实世界结果进行验证。
该框架对专家零负担，并通过被动跟踪专家与AI建议的趋同和分歧提供自动审计追踪。由于它分析的是输出而非内部模型计算，因此在机构更新模型和更换供应商时也能提供治理的连续性。最后，通过提供可靠性分数和语义评估（例如，“此建议类似于500个因违反指南而被专家否决的案例”），它使专家和机构能够在造成损害之前检测出不可靠的AI输出。这通过使领域专家无需机器学习专业知识即可治理AI系统，从而实现了AI监督的民主化。
AI.summary: AI流行病学提出一个新颖的框架，通过对AI输出应用群体层面监测方法，实现对高级AI系统的治理和解释。它通过标准化AI-专家交互数据，建立统计关联来预测输出失败，从而绕过模型复杂性问题。该方法对专家无负担，提供自动审计追踪和治理连续性，并通过可靠性分数赋能领域专家检测和管理AI风险。
AI.keywords: AI流行病学, 可解释AI, 专家监督, 群体层面监测, AI治理
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新性的方法，通过借鉴流行病学的思想来解决AI可解释性和治理的挑战。其核心创新在于将AI输出视为“病例”，通过群体层面统计分析而非深入模型内部机制来评估AI的可靠性。这种方法避免了传统可解释性方法在面对复杂模型时的局限性，并降低了专家参与的门槛，使得领域专家无需机器学习知识也能有效监督AI。这对于AI在关键领域（如医疗）的实际部署具有重要意义。

title: The Agony of Opacity: Foundations for Reflective Interpretability in AI-Mediated Mental Health Support
summary: Throughout history, a prevailing paradigm in mental healthcare has been one in which distressed people may receive treatment with little understanding around how their experience is perceived by their care provider, and in turn, the decisions made by their provider around how treatment will progress. Paralleling this offline model of care, people who seek mental health support from artificial intelligence (AI)-based chatbots are similarly provided little context for how their expressions of distress are processed by the model, and subsequently, any reasoning or theoretical grounding that may underlie model responses. People in severe distress who turn to AI chatbots for support thus find themselves caught between black boxes, contending with unique forms of agony that arise from these intersecting opacities. In this paper, we argue that the distinct psychological state of individuals experiencing severe mental distress uniquely necessitates a higher standard of end-user interpretability in comparison to general AI chatbot use. We propose a reflective interpretability approach to AI-mediated mental health support, which nudges users to engage in an agency-preserving and iterative process of reflection and interpretation of model outputs, towards creating meaning from interactions (rather than accepting outputs as directive instructions). Drawing on interpretability practices from four mental health fields (psychotherapy, crisis intervention, psychiatry, and care authorization), we describe concrete design approaches for reflective interpretability in AI-mediated mental health support, including role induction, prosocial advance directives, intervention titration, and well-defined mechanisms for recourse, alongside a discussion of potential risks and mitigation measures.

AI.title_translation: 不透明的痛苦：AI介导心理健康支持中反思性可解释性的基础
AI.tldr: AI心理健康支持中缺乏透明度导致用户痛苦，本文提出一种反思性可解释性方法，旨在促使用户理解并从AI互动中创造意义。
AI.motivation: 在心理健康护理中，无论是传统模式还是AI介导模式，用户都普遍缺乏对其经历如何被感知以及治疗决策如何做出的理解，这种不透明性给严重心理困扰者带来了独特的痛苦。本文旨在解决AI聊天机器人在心理健康支持中未能提供其响应背后推理或理论基础的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种反思性可解释性方法（reflective interpretability approach），旨在促使用户参与一个保留自主性和迭代的反思与解释模型输出的过程，从而从互动中创造意义。该方法借鉴了心理治疗、危机干预、精神病学和护理授权等四个心理健康领域的可解释性实践，并描述了具体的实现设计，包括角色引入、亲社会预先指示、干预滴定和明确的追索机制。
AI.result: 论文提出并详细描述了AI介导心理健康支持中的反思性可解释性方法及其具体设计原则，旨在提高用户对AI互动的理解并减轻因不透明性带来的痛苦。本文侧重于理论构建和设计建议，而非实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 严重心理困扰个体的独特心理状态要求AI介导心理健康支持中必须采用比一般AI应用更高标准的终端用户可解释性。反思性可解释性方法能够帮助用户理解AI互动并从中创造意义，从而缓解“不透明的痛苦”。
AI.translation: 在历史上，心理健康护理的一个普遍范式是，受困扰的人可能会接受治疗，但对他们的经历如何被护理提供者感知以及护理提供者如何决定治疗进展知之甚少。与这种离线护理模式类似，寻求人工智能（AI）聊天机器人心理健康支持的人们也同样很少获得关于他们的困扰表达如何被模型处理，以及模型响应背后可能存在的任何推理或理论基础的背景信息。因此，那些求助于AI聊天机器人寻求支持的严重困扰者发现自己被困在黑箱之间，与这些交叉的不透明性所产生的独特痛苦形式作斗争。在本文中，我们认为，经历严重心理困扰的个体独特的心理状态，与一般AI聊天机器人使用相比，独特地需要更高标准的终端用户可解释性。我们提出了一种AI介导心理健康支持中的反思性可解释性方法，该方法促使用户参与一个保留自主性和迭代的反思和解释模型输出的过程，以期从互动中创造意义（而不是接受输出作为指令性指示）。借鉴来自四个心理健康领域（心理治疗、危机干预、精神病学和护理授权）的可解释性实践，我们描述了AI介导心理健康支持中反思性可解释性的具体设计方法，包括角色引入、亲社会预先指示、干预滴定和明确的追索机制，同时讨论了潜在风险和缓解措施。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了AI介导心理健康支持中，用户因缺乏透明度而经历的“不透明的痛苦”，并指出严重心理困扰个体的特殊性要求AI具备更高标准的可解释性。为此，论文提出了一种反思性可解释性方法，旨在通过引导用户迭代反思和解释AI输出，使其从互动中创造意义。该方法借鉴了心理治疗、危机干预、精神病学和护理授权等心理健康领域的实践，并提供了具体的AI设计方案，同时讨论了潜在风险及缓解措施。
AI.keywords: AI可解释性, 心理健康支持, 反思性可解释性, 不透明性, 用户代理权
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将心理健康领域中对患者理解和代理权的重视引入AI可解释性研究，提出了“反思性可解释性”这一概念。它强调了在AI应用于心理健康等敏感领域时，不仅要关注技术有效性，更要注重用户的心理安全、自主性和体验。文章从多学科实践中汲取灵感，为未来AI伦理设计和用户中心设计提供了新的视角和具体指导。

title: Phase-space entropy at acquisition reflects downstream learnability
summary: Modern learning systems work with data that vary widely across domains, but they all ultimately depend on how much structure is already present in the measurements before any model is trained. This raises a basic question: is there a general, modality-agnostic way to quantify how acquisition itself preserves or destroys the information that downstream learners could use? Here we propose an acquisition-level scalar $ΔS_{\mathcal B}$ based on instrument-resolved phase space. Unlike pixelwise distortion or purely spectral errors that often saturate under aggressive undersampling, $ΔS_{\mathcal B}$ directly quantifies how acquisition mixes or removes joint space--frequency structure at the instrument scale. We show theoretically that \(ΔS_{\mathcal B}\) correctly identifies the phase-space coherence of periodic sampling as the physical source of aliasing, recovering classical sampling-theorem consequences. Empirically, across masked image classification, accelerated MRI, and massive MIMO (including over-the-air measurements), $|ΔS_{\mathcal B}|$ consistently ranks sampling geometries and predicts downstream reconstruction/recognition difficulty \emph{without training}. In particular, minimizing $|ΔS_{\mathcal B}|$ enables zero-training selection of variable-density MRI mask parameters that matches designs tuned by conventional pre-reconstruction criteria. These results suggest that phase-space entropy at acquisition reflects downstream learnability, enabling pre-training selection of candidate sampling policies and as a shared notion of information preservation across modalities.

AI.title_translation: 采集时的相空间熵反映了下游可学习性
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于仪器分辨相空间的新度量 $ΔS_{\mathcal B}$，可在训练前量化数据采集如何影响下游可学习性，并能预测重建/识别难度和优化采样策略。
AI.motivation: 现代学习系统处理的数据领域广泛，但其性能最终取决于数据采集前已存在的结构。因此，存在一个基本问题：是否存在一种通用的、与模态无关的方法来量化采集本身如何保留或破坏下游学习者可用的信息？
AI.method: 本文提出一个基于仪器分辨相空间的采集级标量 $ΔS_{\mathcal B}$。它直接量化采集如何在仪器尺度上混合或去除联合时空频率结构，这与像素级失真或纯谱误差不同，后者在激进欠采样下常会饱和。
AI.result: 理论上，$ΔS_{\mathcal B}$ 正确识别周期性采样的相空间相干性是混叠的物理来源，并恢复了经典采样定理的结论。实证上，在蒙版图像分类、加速MRI和大规模MIMO（包括无线测量）中，$|ΔS_{\mathcal B}|$ 始终如一地对采样几何进行排序，并在无需训练的情况下预测下游重建/识别难度。特别地，最小化 $|ΔS_{\mathcal B}|$ 可以在零训练下选择可变密度MRI掩模参数，与传统预重建标准调整的设计相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 采集时的相空间熵反映了下游可学习性，这使得在训练前选择候选采样策略成为可能，并提供了一种跨模态信息保存的共享概念。
AI.translation: 现代学习系统处理来自不同领域的数据，但它们最终都取决于在训练任何模型之前测量中已经存在多少结构。这引出了一个基本问题：是否存在一种通用的、与模态无关的方法来量化采集本身如何保留或破坏下游学习者可以使用的信息？在此，我们提出一个基于仪器分辨相空间的采集级标量 $ΔS_{\mathcal B}$。与在激进欠采样下通常饱和的像素级失真或纯谱误差不同，$ΔS_{\mathcal B}$ 直接量化了采集如何在仪器尺度上混合或去除联合时空频率结构。我们理论上证明 $ΔS_{\mathcal B}$ 正确识别周期性采样的相空间相干性是混叠的物理来源，并恢复了经典采样定理的结论。在蒙版图像分类、加速MRI和大规模MIMO（包括无线测量）中，经验表明 $|ΔS_{\mathcal B}|$ 始终如一地对采样几何进行排序，并在无需训练的情况下预测下游重建/识别难度。特别是，最小化 $|ΔS_{\mathcal B}|$ 可以在零训练下选择可变密度MRI掩模参数，与传统预重建标准调整的设计相匹配。这些结果表明，采集时的相空间熵反映了下游可学习性，从而可以在训练前选择候选采样策略，并作为跨模态信息保存的共享概念。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种名为 $ΔS_{\mathcal B}$ 的新采集级标量，它基于仪器分辨相空间，旨在量化数据采集如何影响下游学习系统的可学习性。该方法能够直接衡量采集过程中联合时空频率结构的混合或去除，不同于传统失真度量。理论分析表明其能解释混叠现象并与经典采样定理一致。实验结果显示，$|ΔS_{\mathcal B}|$ 在多种模态（如图像分类、MRI、MIMO）中能有效预测下游重建和识别难度，且无需训练即可优化采样策略，例如选择MRI掩模参数。这表明采集时的相空间熵是下游可学习性的一个重要指标，可用于预训练阶段的采样策略选择。
AI.keywords: 相空间熵, 可学习性, 数据采集, 采样策略, 信息保存
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种新颖且具有普适性的度量方法 $ΔS_{\mathcal B}$，用于在数据采集阶段评估数据对下游学习任务的“可学习性”。其创新之处在于提供了一种与模态无关、无需训练且能直接量化信息保存程度的工具，解决了传统度量在欠采样下失效的问题。其重要性在于，它为优化数据采集策略提供了理论基础和实用方法，有望显著提高各种机器学习应用的效率和性能，尤其是在数据采集受限的场景中。

title: WISE: Web Information Satire and Fakeness Evaluation
comments: This is the author's preprint. Accepted to WEB&GRAPH 2026 (co-located with WSDM 2026), Boise, Idaho, USA, Feb 26, 2026. Final version will appear in WSDM 2026 Companion Proceedings. Conf: https://wsdm-conference.org/2026/ Workshop: https://aiimlab.org/events/WSDM_2026_WEB_and_GRAPH_2026_Workshop_on_Web_and_Graphs_Responsible_Intelligence_and_Social_Media.html
summary: Distinguishing fake or untrue news from satire or humor poses a unique challenge due to their overlapping linguistic features and divergent intent. This study develops WISE (Web Information Satire and Fakeness Evaluation) framework which benchmarks eight lightweight transformer models alongside two baseline models on a balanced dataset of 20,000 samples from Fakeddit, annotated as either fake news or satire. Using stratified 5-fold cross-validation, we evaluate models across comprehensive metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, MCC, Brier score, and Expected Calibration Error. Our evaluation reveals that MiniLM, a lightweight model, achieves the highest accuracy (87.58%) among all models, while RoBERTa-base achieves the highest ROC-AUC (95.42%) and strong accuracy (87.36%). DistilBERT offers an excellent efficiency-accuracy trade-off with 86.28\% accuracy and 93.90\% ROC-AUC. Statistical tests confirm significant performance differences between models, with paired t-tests and McNemar tests providing rigorous comparisons. Our findings highlight that lightweight models can match or exceed baseline performance, offering actionable insights for deploying misinformation detection systems in real-world, resource-constrained settings.

AI.title_translation: WISE：网络信息讽刺与虚假性评估
AI.tldr: WISE框架基准测试了轻量级Transformer模型在区分假新闻和讽刺方面的性能，发现MiniLM等轻量级模型在资源受限环境下表现出色。
AI.motivation: 区分假新闻和讽刺幽默是一个独特的挑战，因为它们具有重叠的语言特征但意图不同。
AI.method: 该研究开发了WISE（Web Information Satire and Fakeness Evaluation）框架，在一个包含20,000个来自Fakeddit的平衡数据集上，基准测试了八个轻量级Transformer模型和两个基线模型。采用分层5折交叉验证，评估了准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数、ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、MCC、Brier分数和预期校准误差等综合指标，并进行了配对t检验和McNemar检验。
AI.result: 评估显示，MiniLM在所有模型中实现了最高的准确率（87.58%），而RoBERTa-base实现了最高的ROC-AUC（95.42%）和较高的准确率（87.36%）。DistilBERT在效率-准确率之间提供了出色的权衡（86.28%准确率和93.90% ROC-AUC）。统计测试证实模型之间存在显著的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级模型可以达到或超过基线性能，为在真实世界、资源受限的环境中部署错误信息检测系统提供了可行的见解。
AI.translation: 区分假新闻或不真实新闻与讽刺或幽默构成了一个独特的挑战，因为它们具有重叠的语言特征但意图不同。本研究开发了WISE（Web Information Satire and Fakeness Evaluation）框架，该框架在一个包含20,000个来自Fakeddit的平衡数据集（被标注为假新闻或讽刺）上，基准测试了八个轻量级Transformer模型和两个基线模型。我们使用分层5折交叉验证，通过包括准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数、ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、MCC、Brier分数和预期校准误差在内的综合指标评估模型。我们的评估显示，轻量级模型MiniLM在所有模型中实现了最高的准确率（87.58%），而RoBERTa-base实现了最高的ROC-AUC（95.42%）和较高的准确率（87.36%）。DistilBERT在86.28%的准确率和93.90%的ROC-AUC之间提供了出色的效率-准确率权衡。统计测试证实了模型之间存在显著的性能差异，其中配对t检验和McNemar检验提供了严格的比较。我们的研究结果强调，轻量级模型可以达到或超过基线性能，为在真实世界、资源受限的环境中部署错误信息检测系统提供了可行的见解。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了WISE框架，旨在区分假新闻和讽刺。该框架在一个包含20,000个样本的数据集上，对八个轻量级Transformer模型和两个基线模型进行了基准测试。结果表明，MiniLM取得了最高的准确率（87.58%），而RoBERTa-base的ROC-AUC最高（95.42%）。DistilBERT在效率和准确率之间取得了良好平衡。研究强调，轻量级模型在资源受限的错误信息检测系统中具有实用价值。
AI.keywords: 假新闻检测, 讽刺检测, 轻量级模型, Transformer, WISE框架
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，它证明了轻量级Transformer模型在区分假新闻和讽刺方面可以与更复杂的基线模型相媲美甚至超越。这对于在资源受限的真实世界环境中部署错误信息检测系统具有重要意义。

title: SPARK: Search Personalization via Agent-Driven Retrieval and Knowledge-sharing
comments: This is the author's preprint. Accepted to WEB&GRAPH 2026 (co-located with WSDM 2026), Boise, Idaho, USA, Feb 26, 2026. Final version will appear in WSDM 2026 Companion Proceedings. Conf: https://wsdm-conference.org/2026/ Workshop: https://aiimlab.org/events/WSDM_2026_WEB_and_GRAPH_2026_Workshop_on_Web_and_Graphs_Responsible_Intelligence_and_Social_Media.html
summary: Personalized search demands the ability to model users' evolving, multi-dimensional information needs; a challenge for systems constrained by static profiles or monolithic retrieval pipelines. We present SPARK (Search Personalization via Agent-Driven Retrieval and Knowledge-sharing), a framework in which coordinated persona-based large language model (LLM) agents deliver task-specific retrieval and emergent personalization. SPARK formalizes a persona space defined by role, expertise, task context, and domain, and introduces a Persona Coordinator that dynamically interprets incoming queries to activate the most relevant specialized agents. Each agent executes an independent retrieval-augmented generation process, supported by dedicated long- and short-term memory stores and context-aware reasoning modules. Inter-agent collaboration is facilitated through structured communication protocols, including shared memory repositories, iterative debate, and relay-style knowledge transfer. Drawing on principles from cognitive architectures, multi-agent coordination theory, and information retrieval, SPARK models how emergent personalization properties arise from distributed agent behaviors governed by minimal coordination rules. The framework yields testable predictions regarding coordination efficiency, personalization quality, and cognitive load distribution, while incorporating adaptive learning mechanisms for continuous persona refinement. By integrating fine-grained agent specialization with cooperative retrieval, SPARK provides insights for next-generation search systems capable of capturing the complexity, fluidity, and context sensitivity of human information-seeking behavior.

AI.title_translation: SPARK：通过代理驱动检索和知识共享实现搜索个性化
AI.tldr: SPARK是一个利用协调的基于角色的LLM代理实现个性化搜索的框架，通过动态激活专业代理并促进代理间协作来满足用户不断变化的信息需求。
AI.motivation: 现有系统受限于静态配置文件或单一检索流程，难以建模用户不断演变的多维度信息需求，因此需要一种新的个性化搜索方法。
AI.method: SPARK框架利用协调的基于角色的LLM代理进行任务特定检索和新兴个性化。它定义了一个由角色、专业知识、任务上下文和领域组成的“角色空间”，并引入一个“角色协调器”来动态解释查询并激活最相关的专业代理。每个代理执行独立的检索增强生成过程，并由记忆存储和上下文感知推理模块支持。代理间通过共享记忆库、迭代辩论和接力式知识转移等结构化通信协议进行协作。
AI.result: 该框架对协调效率、个性化质量和认知负荷分布提出了可验证的预测，并结合了自适应学习机制以持续完善角色。它为下一代搜索系统提供了见解，能够捕捉人类信息寻求行为的复杂性、流动性和上下文敏感性。
AI.conclusion: SPARK通过将细粒度的代理专业化与协作检索相结合，为能够捕捉人类信息寻求行为复杂性、流动性和上下文敏感性的下一代搜索系统提供了见解。
AI.translation: 个性化搜索要求能够建模用户不断演变的多维度信息需求；这对受限于静态配置文件或单一检索管道的系统来说是一个挑战。我们提出了SPARK（通过代理驱动检索和知识共享实现搜索个性化），这是一个框架，其中协调的基于角色的LLM（大型语言模型）代理提供特定任务的检索和新兴的个性化。SPARK将由角色、专业知识、任务上下文和领域定义的角色空间形式化，并引入了一个角色协调器，该协调器动态解释传入查询以激活最相关的专业代理。每个代理执行独立的检索增强生成过程，由专门的长期和短期内存存储以及上下文感知推理模块支持。代理间的协作通过结构化通信协议促进，包括共享内存库、迭代辩论和接力式知识转移。SPARK借鉴了认知架构、多代理协调理论和信息检索的原理，模拟了在最小协调规则下分布式代理行为如何产生新兴的个性化属性。该框架对协调效率、个性化质量和认知负荷分布提出了可验证的预测，同时结合了自适应学习机制以持续完善角色。通过将细粒度的代理专业化与协作检索相结合，SPARK为能够捕捉人类信息寻求行为的复杂性、流动性和上下文敏感性的下一代搜索系统提供了见解。
AI.summary: SPARK是一个创新的个性化搜索框架，它通过协调基于角色的LLM代理来解决传统系统难以建模用户动态信息需求的问题。该框架引入了角色空间和角色协调器，以动态激活专业代理并促进它们之间的协作，从而提供任务特定的检索和新兴个性化。SPARK结合了认知架构和多代理理论，旨在提升协调效率和个性化质量，为构建能够理解复杂人类信息寻求行为的下一代搜索系统提供了新思路。
AI.keywords: 个性化搜索, 大型语言模型代理, 多代理系统, 知识共享, 检索增强生成
AI.comments: SPARK的创新之处在于其多代理LLM架构，通过将用户需求分解为不同“角色”并由专业代理协作处理，有效解决了传统个性化搜索系统面临的挑战。这种方法不仅提升了搜索的个性化和上下文敏感度，还通过动态协调和知识共享机制实现了更灵活、适应性更强的系统。

title: Beyond Homophily: Community Search on Heterophilic Graphs
summary: Community search aims to identify a refined set of nodes that are most relevant to a given query, supporting tasks ranging from fraud detection to recommendation. Unlike homophilic graphs, many real-world networks are heterophilic, where edges predominantly connect dissimilar nodes. Therefore, structural signals that once reflected smooth, low-frequency similarity now appear as sharp, high-frequency contrasts. However, both classical algorithms (e.g., k-core, k-truss) and recent ML-based models struggle to achieve effective community search on heterophilic graphs, where edge signs or semantics are generally unknown. Algorithm-based methods often return communities with mixed class labels, while GNNs, built on homophily, smooth away meaningful signals and blur community boundaries. Therefore, we propose Adaptive Community Search (AdaptCS), a lightweight framework featuring three key designs: (i) an AdaptCS Encoder that disentangles multi-hop and multi-frequency signals, enabling the model to capture both smooth (homophilic) and contrastive (heterophilic) relations; (ii) a memory-efficient low-rank optimization that removes the main computational bottleneck and ensures model scalability; and (iii) an Adaptive Community Score (ACS) that guides online search by balancing embedding similarity and topological relations. Extensive experiments on both heterophilic and homophilic benchmarks demonstrate that AdaptCS outperforms the best-performing baseline by an average of 11% in F1-score, retains robustness across heterophily levels, and achieves up to 2 orders of magnitude speedup over the strongest ML-based CS baselines.

AI.title_translation: 超越同质性：异质图上的社区搜索
AI.tldr: 现有社区搜索方法在异质图上表现不佳，本文提出了AdaptCS框架，通过解耦信号、低秩优化和自适应社区评分，显著提升了异质图和同质图上的社区搜索性能和效率。
AI.motivation: 社区搜索在欺诈检测和推荐等任务中至关重要。然而，许多现实世界的网络是异质的，边主要连接不相似的节点。传统的算法和最近的机器学习模型在异质图上进行社区搜索时面临挑战，因为它们要么返回类别混合的社区，要么平滑掉有意义的信号并模糊社区边界。
AI.method: 本文提出了自适应社区搜索（AdaptCS）框架，包含三个关键设计：(i) AdaptCS编码器，用于解耦多跳和多频率信号，以捕获平滑（同质）和对比（异质）关系；(ii) 内存高效的低秩优化，消除计算瓶颈并确保模型可扩展性；(iii) 自适应社区评分（ACS），通过平衡嵌入相似性和拓扑关系来指导在线搜索。
AI.result: AdaptCS在异质和同质基准测试中，F1-score平均比最佳基线高出11%，在不同异质性水平下保持鲁棒性，并且比最强的基于ML的CS基线实现了高达2个数量级的加速。
AI.conclusion: AdaptCS框架通过有效处理异质图的特点，显著提升了社区搜索的性能和效率，并在同质图上也表现出色，解决了现有方法在异质图上社区搜索的挑战。
AI.translation: 社区搜索旨在识别一组与给定查询最相关的节点，支持从欺诈检测到推荐等任务。与同质图不同，许多真实世界的网络是异质的，其中边主要连接不相似的节点。因此，曾经反映平滑、低频相似性的结构信号现在表现为尖锐、高频的对比。然而，无论是经典算法（例如k-core、k-truss）还是最近基于机器学习的模型，都难以在异质图上实现有效的社区搜索，因为边符号或语义通常未知。基于算法的方法通常返回具有混合类别标签的社区，而基于同质性构建的GNN会平滑掉有意义的信号并模糊社区边界。因此，我们提出了自适应社区搜索（AdaptCS），一个轻量级框架，具有三个关键设计：(i) AdaptCS编码器，它解耦多跳和多频率信号，使模型能够捕获平滑（同质）和对比（异质）关系；(ii) 内存高效的低秩优化，消除了主要的计算瓶颈并确保了模型的可扩展性；(iii) 自适应社区评分（ACS），通过平衡嵌入相似性和拓扑关系来指导在线搜索。在异质和同质基准上的大量实验表明，AdaptCS在F1-score上平均优于最佳基线11%，在不同异质性水平下保持鲁棒性，并且比最强的基于ML的CS基线实现了高达2个数量级的加速。
AI.summary: 本文针对异质图上的社区搜索挑战，提出了AdaptCS框架。该框架通过AdaptCS编码器解耦多跳和多频率信号以捕获同质和异质关系，采用内存高效的低秩优化提高可扩展性，并通过自适应社区评分平衡嵌入相似性和拓扑关系指导搜索。实验证明，AdaptCS在F1-score上平均优于现有最佳基线11%，并实现了显著的运行速度提升，有效解决了异质图社区搜索的难题。
AI.keywords: 异质图, 社区搜索, AdaptCS, 图神经网络, 低秩优化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个能够有效处理异质图（边连接不相似节点）上社区搜索的框架AdaptCS。通过解耦多跳和多频率信号的能力，模型能够同时捕捉同质和异质关系，克服了传统方法和现有GNN在异质图上的局限性。内存高效的低秩优化和自适应社区评分也显著提升了模型的效率和搜索精度，使其在理论和实践中都具有重要意义。

title: The Invisible Hand of AI Libraries Shaping Open Source Projects and Communities
comments: ACCEPTED REGISTERED REPORT AT SANER (CORE A*) 2026
summary:
In the early 1980s, Open Source Software emerged as a revolutionary concept amidst the dominance of proprietary software. What began as a revolutionary idea has now become the cornerstone of computer science. Amidst OSS projects, AI is increasing its presence and relevance. However, despite the growing popularity of AI, its adoption and impacts on OSS projects remain underexplored.
  We aim to assess the adoption of AI libraries in Python and Java OSS projects and examine how they shape development, including the technical ecosystem and community engagement. To this end, we will perform a large-scale analysis on 157.7k potential OSS repositories, employing repository metrics and software metrics to compare projects adopting AI libraries against those that do not. We expect to identify measurable differences in development activity, community engagement, and code complexity between OSS projects that adopt AI libraries and those that do not, offering evidence-based insights into how AI integration reshapes software development practices.

AI.title_translation: AI库的无形之手塑造开源项目和社区
AI.tldr: 本研究旨在评估Python和Java开源项目中AI库的采用情况，并检查它们如何影响开发、技术生态系统和社区参与，通过大规模分析来识别采用AI库的项目与未采用AI库的项目之间的可衡量差异。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI日益普及，但其在开源项目中的采用及其影响仍未得到充分探索。本研究旨在评估AI库在开源项目中的采用情况，并检查它们如何塑造开发，包括技术生态系统和社区参与。
AI.method: 对15.77万个潜在的开源存储库进行大规模分析，采用存储库指标和软件指标来比较采用AI库的项目与未采用AI库的项目。
AI.result: 预计将在开发活动、社区参与和代码复杂性方面识别出采用AI库的开源项目与未采用AI库的项目之间的可衡量差异。
AI.translation:
20世纪80年代初，开源软件作为专有软件主导地位下的一项革命性概念应运而生。最初的革命性思想现已成为计算机科学的基石。在开源软件项目中，AI正日益增强其存在感和相关性。然而，尽管AI日益普及，但其在开源项目中的采用及其影响仍未得到充分探索。
我们旨在评估Python和Java开源项目中AI库的采用情况，并检查它们如何塑造开发，包括技术生态系统和社区参与。为此，我们将对15.77万个潜在的开源存储库进行大规模分析，采用存储库指标和软件指标来比较采用AI库的项目与未采用AI库的项目。我们期望在采用AI库的开源项目与未采用AI库的项目之间，在开发活动、社区参与和代码复杂性方面识别出可衡量的差异，从而为AI集成如何重塑软件开发实践提供基于证据的见解。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在探讨AI库在Python和Java开源项目中的采用情况及其对项目开发、技术生态系统和社区参与的影响。通过对15.77万个潜在存储库进行大规模分析，研究将比较采用AI库与未采用AI库的项目，以识别开发活动、社区参与和代码复杂性方面的可衡量差异，从而提供关于AI集成如何影响软件开发的见解。
AI.keywords: AI库, 开源项目, 软件开发, 社区参与, Python, Java
AI.comments: 这项研究具有重要的现实意义，因为它揭示了AI库在开源生态系统中的日益增长的影响力。通过大规模数据分析，它有望提供关于AI如何“无形地”塑造软件开发实践的实证见解。其创新之处在于首次大规模地量化AI库对开源项目具体方面的影响。

title: Fluid Agency in AI Systems: A Case for Functional Equivalence in Copyright, Patent, and Tort
comments: Author accepted manuscript. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2504.04058
summary: Modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems lack human-like consciousness or culpability, yet they exhibit fluid agency: behavior that is (i) stochastic (probabilistic and path-dependent), (ii) dynamic (co-evolving with user interaction), and (iii) adaptive (able to reorient across contexts). Fluid agency generates valuable outputs but collapses attribution, irreducibly entangling human and machine inputs. This fundamental unmappability fractures doctrines that assume traceable provenance -- authorship, inventorship, and liability -- yielding ownership gaps and moral "crumple zones." This Article argues that only functional equivalence stabilizes doctrine. Where provenance is indeterminate, legal frameworks must treat human and AI contributions as equivalent for allocating rights and responsibility -- not as a claim of moral or economic parity but as a pragmatic default. This principle stabilizes doctrine across domains, offering administrable rules: in copyright, vesting ownership in human orchestrators without parsing inseparable contributions; in patent, tying inventor-of-record status to human orchestration and reduction to practice, even when AI supplies the pivotal insight; and in tort, replacing intractable causation inquiries with enterprise-level and sector-specific strict or no-fault schemes. The contribution is both descriptive and normative: fluid agency explains why origin-based tests fail, while functional equivalence supplies an outcome-focused framework to allocate rights and responsibility when attribution collapses.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能系统中的流动能动性：版权、专利和侵权中的功能等价性主张
AI.tldr: AI的“流动能动性”行为（随机、动态、自适应）模糊了人机贡献的界限，导致权责归属困难。文章提出“功能等价”原则，即在无法追溯来源时，将人机贡献视为等同，以稳定版权、专利和侵权法，将所有权、发明人和责任归于人类协调者或相关企业。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统虽然缺乏意识，但表现出“流动能动性”，即随机、动态和自适应的行为，这种行为产生了有价值的输出，但却模糊了人机贡献的界限，导致权责归属困难，并产生所有权真空和道德“缓冲地带”。
AI.method: 文章提出“功能等价”原则，主张在无法确定来源时，法律框架应将人类和AI的贡献视为等同，以此来分配权利和责任。具体而言，在版权法中，将所有权赋予人类协调者；在专利法中，将发明人身份与人类协调和实践相结合；在侵权法中，用企业责任或无过错赔偿方案取代因果关系追溯。
AI.result: 流动能动性解释了基于起源的测试为何会失败，而功能等价性提供了一个以结果为导向的框架，用于在无法进行归因时分配权利和责任。
AI.conclusion: 流动能动性解释了为何基于起源的法律测试在AI时代会失效，而功能等价原则为在无法追踪具体贡献时分配权利和责任提供了一个务实且可操作的解决方案。
AI.translation: 现代人工智能（AI）系统缺乏类似人类的意识或可归咎性，但它们表现出流动的能动性：行为（i）是随机的（概率性的和路径依赖的），（ii）是动态的（与用户交互共同演变的），以及（iii）是自适应的（能够跨越不同情境重新定向）。流动能动性产生了有价值的输出，但却模糊了归因，不可避免地将人类和机器的输入纠缠在一起。这种根本性的无法映射性破坏了假设可追踪来源的法律原则——作者身份、发明身份和责任——从而产生了所有权空白和道德“缓冲地带”。本文认为，只有功能等价性才能稳定法律原则。在来源不确定的情况下，法律框架必须将人类和AI的贡献视为等同，以分配权利和责任——这不是声称道德或经济上的平等，而是作为一种务实的默认选择。这一原则稳定了跨领域的法律原则，提供了可管理的规则：在版权法中，将所有权赋予人类协调者，而不必区分不可分割的贡献；在专利法中，将发明人身份与人类协调和实践相关联，即使AI提供了关键的见解；在侵权法中，用企业层面的和特定领域的严格责任或无过错赔偿方案取代棘手的因果关系调查。本文的贡献既是描述性的也是规范性的：流动能动性解释了为何基于起源的测试会失败，而功能等价性则提供了一个以结果为导向的框架，用于在归因失败时分配权利和责任。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了AI系统“流动能动性”带来的法律挑战，即AI行为的随机性、动态性和自适应性模糊了人机贡献的界限，使得传统的版权、专利和侵权法难以适用。文章提出“功能等价”原则，主张在无法追溯具体来源时，应将人机贡献视为等同，并将权利和责任归于人类协调者或相关企业，以确保法律的稳定性和可操作性。
AI.keywords: 流动能动性, 功能等价, 版权, 专利, 侵权法
AI.comments: 该文深刻指出了AI发展对现有法律体系带来的根本性挑战，并提出了“功能等价”这一创新的解决方案。文章的论证逻辑清晰，从AI的“流动能动性”这一核心特征出发，层层递进地分析了其在版权、专利和侵权法领域造成的具体问题，并最终提出了具有实践指导意义的原则。然而，在具体实施层面，如何界定“人类协调者”以及如何公平地分配企业责任，仍需进一步的细化和探讨。

title: The AI Pyramid A Conceptual Framework for Workforce Capability in the Age of AI
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) represents a qualitative shift in technological change by extending cognitive labor itself rather than merely automating routine tasks. Recent evidence shows that generative AI disproportionately affects highly educated, white collar work, challenging existing assumptions about workforce vulnerability and rendering traditional approaches to digital or AI literacy insufficient. This paper introduces the concept of AI Nativity, the capacity to integrate AI fluidly into everyday reasoning, problem solving, and decision making, and proposes the AI Pyramid, a conceptual framework for organizing human capability in an AI mediated economy. The framework distinguishes three interdependent capability layers: AI Native capability as a universal baseline for participation in AI augmented environments; AI Foundation capability for building, integrating, and sustaining AI enabled systems; and AI Deep capability for advancing frontier AI knowledge and applications. Crucially, the pyramid is not a career ladder but a system level distribution of capabilities required at scale. Building on this structure, the paper argues that effective AI workforce development requires treating capability formation as infrastructure rather than episodic training, centered on problem based learning embedded in work contexts and supported by dynamic skill ontologies and competency based measurement. The framework has implications for organizations, education systems, and governments seeking to align learning, measurement, and policy with the evolving demands of AI mediated work, while addressing productivity, resilience, and inequality at societal scale.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能金字塔：人工智能时代劳动力能力的概念框架
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了“人工智能本土化”和“人工智能金字塔”框架，以应对生成式人工智能对高技能白领工作的颠覆性影响。该框架区分了三种能力层级：人工智能本土能力、人工智能基础能力和人工智能深度能力，强调系统性能力建设而非碎片化培训，并为组织、教育系统和政府提供了应对人工智能驱动的工作变革的指导。
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能对高技能白领工作的影响，以及传统数字素养方法的不足，需要新的劳动力能力框架。
AI.method: 提出“人工智能本土化”概念和“人工智能金字塔”框架，该框架包含三个相互依存的能力层级：人工智能本土能力、人工智能基础能力和人工智能深度能力。
AI.result: 提出了一个概念框架，用于组织人工智能时代的人类能力，并强调了系统性能力建设的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 有效的人工智能劳动力发展需要将能力建设视为基础设施，并以基于问题的学习为中心，以应对不断变化的人工智能驱动的工作需求，同时解决社会生产力、韧性和不平等问题。
AI.translation: 人工智能代表了技术变革的质的转变，因为它延伸了认知劳动本身，而不仅仅是自动化常规任务。最近的证据表明，生成式人工智能对受过高等教育的白领工作的影响尤为严重，挑战了现有的关于劳动力脆弱性的假设，并使得传统的数字或人工智能素养方法不足以应对。本文提出了人工智能本土化（AI Nativity）的概念，即在日常推理、解决问题和决策中流畅整合人工智能的能力，并提出了人工智能金字塔（AI Pyramid）的概念框架，用于组织人工智能中介经济中的人类能力。该框架区分了三个相互依存的能力层级：作为参与人工智能增强环境的普遍基线的人工智能本土能力；用于构建、集成和维持人工智能支持的系统的 A I基础能力；以及用于推进前沿人工智能知识和应用的 AI深度能力。至关重要的是，该金字塔不是职业阶梯，而是大规模所需的能力的系统级分布。在此结构的基础上，本文认为，有效的人工智能劳动力发展需要将能力建设视为基础设施而非零散培训，以工作情境为中心，以问题为基础的学习，并辅以动态技能本体和基于能力的测量。该框架对寻求将学习、测量和政策与人工智能中介工作的不断变化的需求相结合的组织、教育系统和政府具有启示意义，同时解决了社会规模的生产力、韧性和不平等问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“人工智能金字塔”框架，这是一个概念模型，用于组织和理解在人工智能时代所需的劳动力能力。该框架区分了三个层级：人工智能本土能力（AI Native capability）、人工智能基础能力（AI Foundation capability）和人工智能深度能力（AI Deep capability），旨在为应对生成式人工智能对认知劳动的影响提供指导。文章强调，能力建设应被视为一种基础设施，而非孤立的培训，并应通过嵌入工作实践的问题导向型学习来促进。
AI.keywords: 人工智能金字塔, 人工智能本土化, 劳动力能力, 能力建设, 人工智能素养
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个新颖且重要的概念框架，即“人工智能金字塔”，以应对人工智能对劳动力能力提出的挑战。该框架区分了不同层级的人工智能能力，并强调了将能力建设视为基础设施的重要性，这对于教育和政策制定具有重要的现实意义。然而，该框架的具体实施细节以及如何有效衡量和培养这些能力仍有待进一步探讨。

title: Majority-Logic Decoding of Binary Locally Recoverable Codes: A Probabilistic Analysis
summary: Locally repairable codes (LRCs) were originally introduced to enable efficient recovery from erasures in distributed storage systems by accessing only a small number of other symbols. While their structural properties-such as bounds and constructions-have been extensively studied, the performance of LRCs under random erasures and errors has remained largely unexplored. In this work, we study the error- and erasure-correction performance of binary linear LRCs under majority-logic decoding (MLD). Focusing on LRCs with fixed locality and varying availability, we derive explicit upper bounds on the probability of decoding failure over the memoryless Binary Erasure Channel (BEC) and Binary Symmetric Channel (BSC). Our analysis characterizes the behavior of the bit-error rate (BER) and block-error rate (BLER) as functions of the locality and availability parameters. We show that, under mild growth conditions on the availability, the block decoding failure probability vanishes asymptotically, and that majority-logic decoding can successfully correct virtually all of error and erasure patterns of weight linear in the blocklength. The results reveal a substantial gap between worst-case guarantees and typical performance under stochastic channel models.

AI.title_translation: 二进制局部可恢复码的多数逻辑解码：概率分析
AI.tldr: 本文通过多数逻辑解码，概率性分析了二进制局部可恢复码在随机擦除和错误下的纠错性能，发现其典型性能远优于最坏情况。
AI.motivation: 局部可恢复码（LRCs）的结构特性已被广泛研究，但其在随机擦除和错误下的性能仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 研究者通过多数逻辑解码（MLD）研究了二进制线性LRCs的纠错性能，并推导了在无记忆二元擦除信道（BEC）和二元对称信道（BSC）下解码失败概率的显式上限。分析重点关注具有固定局部性和不同可用性的LRCs。
AI.result: 分析揭示了误码率（BER）和块错误率（BLER）作为局部性和可用性参数的函数行为。结果表明，在可用性温和增长的条件下，块解码失败概率渐近消失，并且多数逻辑解码几乎可以纠正所有块长度线性权重的错误和擦除模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了随机信道模型下最坏情况保证与典型性能之间存在巨大差距。
AI.translation: 局部可恢复码（LRCs）最初被引入，旨在通过仅访问少量其他符号来有效恢复分布式存储系统中的擦除。虽然它们的结构特性——例如界限和构造——已被广泛研究，但LRCs在随机擦除和错误下的性能在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们研究了多数逻辑解码（MLD）下二进制线性LRCs的纠错和擦除纠正性能。我们专注于具有固定局部性和不同可用性的LRCs，推导了在无记忆二元擦除信道（BEC）和二元对称信道（BSC）下解码失败概率的显式上限。我们的分析表征了误码率（BER）和块错误率（BLER）作为局部性和可用性参数的函数行为。我们表明，在可用性温和增长的条件下，块解码失败概率渐近消失，并且多数逻辑解码可以成功纠正几乎所有块长度线性权重的错误和擦除模式。结果揭示了在随机信道模型下，最坏情况保证与典型性能之间存在巨大差距。
AI.summary: 本文通过多数逻辑解码（MLD）对二进制局部可恢复码（LRCs）在随机擦除和错误下的性能进行了概率分析。研究推导了在二元擦除信道（BEC）和二元对称信道（BSC）下解码失败概率的上限，并分析了误码率（BER）和块错误率（BLER）与局部性和可用性参数的关系。结果表明，MLD在特定条件下能有效纠正错误和擦除，且典型性能远优于最坏情况。
AI.keywords: 局部可恢复码, 多数逻辑解码, 概率分析, 纠错性能, 分布式存储
AI.comments: 这项工作通过概率分析揭示了局部可恢复码（LRCs）在实际应用中的潜在性能，弥补了现有研究主要关注结构特性而忽略实际性能的空白。发现典型性能与最坏情况之间存在显著差距，为LRCs的实际部署和设计提供了重要见解，可能促使未来研究更多关注平均情况性能。

title: Cluster Workload Allocation: Semantic Soft Affinity Using Natural Language Processing
comments: This is the accepted version of the paper published in IEEE Access (2026). The final version is available at: https://doi.org/10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3665989
summary: Cluster workload allocation often requires complex configurations, creating a usability gap. This paper introduces a semantic, intent-driven scheduling paradigm for cluster systems using Natural Language Processing. The system employs a Large Language Model (LLM) integrated via a Kubernetes scheduler extender to interpret natural language allocation hint annotations for soft affinity preferences. A prototype featuring a cluster state cache and an intent analyzer (using AWS Bedrock) was developed. Empirical evaluation demonstrated high LLM parsing accuracy (>95% Subset Accuracy on an evaluation ground-truth dataset) for top-tier models like Amazon Nova Pro/Premier and Mistral Pixtral Large, significantly outperforming a baseline engine. Scheduling quality tests across six scenarios showed the prototype achieved superior or equivalent placement compared to standard Kubernetes configurations, particularly excelling in complex and quantitative scenarios and handling conflicting soft preferences. The results validate using LLMs for accessible scheduling but highlight limitations like synchronous LLM latency, suggesting asynchronous processing for production readiness. This work confirms the viability of semantic soft affinity for simplifying workload orchestration and presents a proof-of-concept design.

AI.title_translation: 集群工作负载分配：使用自然语言处理的语义软亲和性
AI.tldr: 为了解决集群配置的复杂性，研究人员使用LLM和NLP技术，允许用户通过自然语言注释来定义“软亲和性”偏好，从而实现更易用的工作负载调度。测试表明，这种方法解析准确率高，调度效果好，但需要解决LLM的同步延迟问题以达到生产标准。
AI.motivation: 集群工作负载分配通常需要复杂的配置，这造成了可用性差距。
AI.method: 该系统采用了一种由意图驱动的调度范式，通过将大型语言模型（LLM）集成到Kubernetes调度器扩展中，来解释自然语言的分配提示注释，以实现软亲和性偏好。原型包括一个集群状态缓存和一个意图分析器（使用AWS Bedrock）。
AI.result: 经验评估显示，对于亚马逊Nova Pro/Premier和Mistral Pixtral Large等顶级模型，LLM的解析准确率（在评估基准数据集上超过95%的子集准确率）很高，显著优于基线引擎。在六个场景的调度质量测试中，原型在复杂和量化场景中表现尤为突出，并且能够处理冲突的软偏好，取得了优于或等同于标准Kubernetes配置的放置效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了使用LLM实现语义软亲和性在简化工作负载编排方面的可行性，并提出了一个概念验证设计，但强调了同步LLM延迟是生产部署需要解决的问题。
AI.translation: 集群工作负载分配通常需要复杂的配置，造成了可用性差距。本文介绍了一种使用自然语言处理（NLP）的集群系统的语义、意图驱动的调度范式。该系统采用了一个与Kubernetes调度器扩展集成的的大型语言模型（LLM），用于解释自然语言分配提示注释以实现软亲和性偏好。开发了一个包含集群状态缓存和意图分析器（使用AWS Bedrock）的原型。经验评估表明，对于亚马逊Nova Pro/Premier和Mistral Pixtral Large等顶级模型，LLM的解析准确率（在评估基准数据集上超过95%的子集准确率）很高，显著优于基线引擎。在六个场景的调度质量测试中，原型实现了优于或等同于标准Kubernetes配置的放置，特别是在复杂和量化场景中表现出色，并能处理冲突的软偏好。结果验证了使用LLM实现可访问调度的可行性，但也突出了同步LLM延迟等局限性，提示需要异步处理以实现生产就绪性。这项工作证实了语义软亲和性在简化工作负载编排方面的可行性，并提出了一个概念验证设计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于自然语言处理（NLP）的语义、意图驱动的集群调度范式，旨在通过大型语言模型（LLM）解释自然语言提示注释来实现工作负载的“语义软亲和性”，从而简化复杂的集群配置。原型在准确性测试中表现出色，并在实际调度场景中展现出优于或等同于标准Kubernetes的性能，证明了该方法的有效性，但指出了同步LLM延迟是未来需要解决的生产就绪性问题。
AI.keywords: 语义软亲和性, 工作负载分配, 自然语言处理, Kubernetes调度, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于使用LLM和自然语言处理（NLP）来驱动集群工作负载的“语义软亲和性”调度，极大地简化了用户配置的复杂性。其重要性在于提供了一种更直观、更易用的集群资源分配方式。局限性在于同步LLM调用带来的延迟问题。

title: SyncTwin: Fast Digital Twin Construction and Synchronization for Safe Robotic Manipulation
summary: Accurate and safe robotic manipulation under dynamic and visually occluded conditions remains a core challenge in real-world deployment. We introduce SyncTwin, a novel digital twin framework that unifies fast 3D scene reconstruction and real-to-sim synchronization for robust and safety-aware robotic manipulation in such environments. In the offline stage, we employ VGGT to rapidly reconstruct object-level 3D assets from RGB images, forming a reusable geometry library. During execution, SyncTwin continuously synchronizes the digital twin by tracking real-world object states via point cloud segmentation updates and aligning them through colored-ICP registration. The synchronized twin enables motion planners to compute collision-free and dynamically feasible trajectories in simulation, which are safely executed on the real robot through a closed real-to-sim-to-real loop. Experiments in dynamic and occluded scenes show that SyncTwin improves manipulation performance and motion safety, demonstrating the effectiveness of digital twin synchronization for real-world robotic execution. The video demos and code can be found on the project website: https://sync-twin.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: SyncTwin：用于安全机器人操作的快速数字孪生构建与同步
AI.tldr: SyncTwin是一个数字孪生框架，通过快速3D场景重建和实时同步，实现动态和视觉遮挡条件下的安全机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 在动态和视觉遮挡条件下，实现准确和安全的机器人操作仍然是实际部署中的核心挑战。
AI.method: SyncTwin框架包括离线阶段和执行阶段。离线阶段，使用VGGT从RGB图像快速重建对象级3D资产，形成可重用的几何库。执行阶段，通过点云分割更新跟踪真实世界对象状态，并通过彩色ICP配准对齐，持续同步数字孪生。同步的孪生体使运动规划器能够在仿真中计算无碰撞且动态可行的轨迹，并通过闭环实时-仿真-实时循环在真实机器人上安全执行。
AI.result: 实验表明，SyncTwin在动态和遮挡场景中提高了操作性能和运动安全性。
AI.conclusion: SyncTwin证明了数字孪生同步对于真实世界机器人执行的有效性。
AI.translation: 在动态和视觉遮挡条件下，实现准确和安全的机器人操作仍然是实际部署中的核心挑战。我们引入了SyncTwin，这是一个新颖的数字孪生框架，它统一了快速3D场景重建和实时-仿真同步，以在此类环境中实现鲁棒且安全感知的机器人操作。在离线阶段，我们使用VGGT从RGB图像快速重建对象级3D资产，形成一个可重用的几何库。在执行过程中，SyncTwin通过点云分割更新跟踪真实世界对象状态，并通过彩色ICP配准对其进行对齐，从而持续同步数字孪生。同步的孪生体使运动规划器能够在仿真中计算无碰撞且动态可行的轨迹，这些轨迹通过闭环实时-仿真-实时循环在真实机器人上安全执行。在动态和遮挡场景中的实验表明，SyncTwin提高了操作性能和运动安全性，证明了数字孪生同步对于真实世界机器人执行的有效性。视频演示和代码可在项目网站上找到：https://sync-twin.github.io/。
AI.summary: SyncTwin是一个新颖的数字孪生框架，旨在解决动态和视觉遮挡环境下机器人操作的准确性和安全性问题。它通过离线阶段使用VGGT快速重建3D对象资产，并在线阶段通过点云分割和彩色ICP配准持续同步数字孪生。同步后的数字孪生使运动规划器能够生成安全的轨迹，并在真实机器人上执行。实验结果表明，SyncTwin提高了操作性能和运动安全性。
AI.keywords: 数字孪生, 机器人操作, 3D重建, 实时同步, 运动规划
AI.comments: SyncTwin的创新之处在于其统一了快速3D场景重建和实时-仿真同步，为复杂真实世界环境中的机器人操作提供了鲁棒且安全的方法。其离线几何库构建和在线持续同步的结合，有效解决了动态和遮挡条件下的挑战，对机器人领域具有重要意义。

title: Alignment Pretraining: AI Discourse Causes Self-Fulfilling (Mis)alignment
summary: Pretraining corpora contain extensive discourse about AI systems, yet the causal influence of this discourse on downstream alignment remains poorly understood. If prevailing descriptions of AI behaviour are predominantly negative, LLMs may internalise corresponding behavioural priors, giving rise to self-fulfilling misalignment. This paper provides the first controlled study of this hypothesis by pretraining 6.9B-parameter LLMs with varying amounts of (mis)alignment discourse. We find that discussion of AI contributes to misalignment. Upsampling synthetic training documents about AI misalignment leads to a notable increase in misaligned behaviour. Conversely, upsampling documents about aligned behaviour reduces misalignment scores from 45% to 9%. We consider this evidence of self-fulfilling alignment. These effects are dampened, but persist through post-training. Our findings establish the study of how pretraining data shapes alignment priors, or alignment pretraining, as a complement to post-training. We recommend practitioners consider pretraining for alignment alongside capabilities. We share our models, data, and evaluations at AlignmentPretraining.ai.

AI.title_translation: 对齐预训练：AI话语导致自我实现的（错位）对齐
AI.tldr: 预训练语料库中关于AI的讨论会显著影响大型语言模型（LLM）的对齐。负面或错位的话语会增加错位行为，而正面或对齐的话语则能有效减少错位，证实了自我实现的（错）对齐效应。
AI.motivation: 预训练语料库中存在大量关于AI系统的话语，但这些话语对下游对齐的因果影响尚不清楚。如果对AI行为的普遍描述是负面的，LLM可能会内化相应的行为先验，从而导致自我实现的错位。
AI.method: 通过预训练6.9B参数的LLM，并引入不同数量的（错位）对齐话语，进行了首次受控研究来验证这一假设。
AI.result: 研究发现，关于AI的讨论确实会导致错位。增加关于AI错位行为的合成训练文档会导致错位行为显著增加。相反，增加关于对齐行为的文档能将错位分数从45%降低到9%。这些影响在后训练中有所减弱但仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 预训练数据会塑造对齐先验，即“对齐预训练”是对后训练的补充。建议从业者在考虑模型能力的同时，也应考虑进行对齐预训练。
AI.translation: 预训练语料库包含大量关于AI系统的话语，然而这些话语对下游对齐的因果影响仍然知之甚少。如果对AI行为的普遍描述主要是负面的，LLM可能会内化相应的行为先验，从而导致自我实现的错位。本文通过预训练6.9B参数的LLM，其中包含不同数量的（错位）对齐话语，首次对这一假设进行了受控研究。我们发现，关于AI的讨论导致了错位。增加关于AI错位行为的合成训练文档会导致错位行为的显著增加。相反，增加关于对齐行为的文档将错位分数从45%降低到9%。我们认为这是自我实现对齐的证据。这些影响在后训练中有所减弱，但仍然存在。我们的发现确立了研究预训练数据如何塑造对齐先验（即对齐预训练）作为后训练的补充。我们建议从业者在考虑能力的同时，也应考虑对齐预训练。我们将在AlignmentPretraining.ai分享我们的模型、数据和评估。
AI.summary: 本文首次通过受控实验研究了预训练语料库中关于AI的话语对大型语言模型（LLM）对齐的影响。研究发现，模型在预训练阶段接触到的AI相关话语会形成“自我实现的（错）对齐”：增加关于AI错位行为的讨论会显著提升模型的错位倾向，而增加关于对齐行为的讨论则能有效降低错位。这些影响即使在后训练后依然存在。研究强调了“对齐预训练”的重要性，建议从业者在开发LLM时，应在预训练阶段就考虑对齐问题。
AI.keywords: 对齐预训练, 大型语言模型, 自我实现, 错位, 预训练数据
AI.comments: 这项研究具有重要的创新性，它首次系统地揭示了预训练数据中关于AI的元话语对模型对齐的深层因果影响，提出了“对齐预训练”这一新颖且关键的视角。它挑战了以往主要关注后训练对齐的范式，强调了在模型生命周期早期阶段干预对齐的重要性，为解决LLM的对齐问题提供了全新的研究方向和实践指导，具有重要的理论和实践价值。

title: AWED-FiNER: Agents, Web applications, and Expert Detectors for Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition across 36 Languages for 6.6 Billion Speakers
comments: Submitted to SIGIR'26 Low-resource Environments Track
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a foundational task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Information Retrieval (IR), which facilitates semantic search and structured data extraction. We introduce \textbf{AWED-FiNER}, an open-source collection of agentic tool, web application, and 53 state-of-the-art expert models that provide Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (FgNER) solutions across 36 languages spoken by more than 6.6 billion people. The agentic tool enables routing multilingual text to specialized expert models to fetch FgNER annotations within seconds. The web-based platform provides a ready-to-use FgNER annotation service for non-technical users. Moreover, the collection of language-specific extremely small open-source state-of-the-art expert models facilitates offline deployment in resource-constrained scenarios, including edge devices. AWED-FiNER covers languages spoken by over 6.6 billion people, ranging from global languages like English, Chinese, Spanish, and Hindi, to low-resource languages like Assamese, Santali, and Odia, along with a specific focus on extremely low-resource vulnerable languages such as Bodo, Manipuri, Bishnupriya, and Mizo. The resources can be accessed here: Agentic Tool (https://github.com/PrachuryyaKaushik/AWED-FiNER), Web Application (https://hf.co/spaces/prachuryyaIITG/AWED-FiNER), and 53 Expert Detector Models (https://hf.co/collections/prachuryyaIITG/awed-finer).
